name: Christine Drazan
subject: FWD: Oregon education is under attack again
body:
Friend, I wanted to make sure you got my message yesterday. [_**The Board of Education is meeting tomorrow morning and we are still 400 sign ups away from meeting our goal.**_](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-r/)**Friend, if we don 't do something now, the Board will remove literacy, math, and reading standards for students for the next four years.** We need to come together and stand up for our students and our education system. The future of our state is at risk.[_**If you haven 't already, it's not too late to email the board and let them know that you are against lowering the standards for Oregon education.**_](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-y/)Thank you,Christine Drazan\---------- Forwarded message ---------

From:**Christine Drazan <[info@anewdirection-or.com](mailto:info@anewdirection-or.com)>**
Date: Tue, Oct 17, 2023 at 6:11 PM
Subject: Oregon education is under attack again
To: Friend <dpwillis67@gmail.com> **Friend, last month, the Oregon State Board of Education introduced a proposal to suspend graduation standards that measure students' ability to read, write, and do math.** In response to widespread public opposition, the Board temporarily withdrew the proposal from their agenda. **However, now the proposal is back on their agenda for their upcoming meeting this Thursday, October 19.**[_**We can't stop now. Join me in urging them to permanently remove this misguided proposal from consideration.**_](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-j/) I know you agree that our students deserve rigorous standards to ensure they are well-prepared for the challenges of the real world -- to allow them to achieve their hopes and dreams for a bright future. [](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-t/) What is even more concerning is the [dismissive attitude displayed by the Board Chair](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-i/) toward concerned parents and community members who oppose the suspension of these critical graduation standards. She has labeled those who hold valid concerns as engaging in "misinformation," "bigotry," and "racism."**This response to genuine stakeholder concerns about the weakening of education standards, set by the board, is disrespectful and troubling.** The Board's decision to reinstate this proposal is especially alarming given unanimous opposition in submitted testimony to the proposal from the public. [PROTECT OUR STUDENTS' FUTURES](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-d/) Friend, we cannot allow our education system's standards to be watered down. Our children's future and the future of our community hangs in the balance. [_**There is still time for us to stop them. Take action today by contacting the Oregon State Board of Education. We need all comments to be received before their meeting on October 19**_](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-h/)\--so please do your part today. Join me in support of high standards-- and a bright future for our kids. [](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-o/) We can't do this without you. Please join us. It's time to tell the bureaucrats to put our kids ahead of their political agendas. Thank you for your support. Christine Drazan [](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-b/)[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-n/)[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-p/)[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-x/) | [Preferences](https://andor.updatemyprofile.com/y-xluilik-172B6299-dihkkhuuli-m) | [Unsubscribe](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-u-xluilik-dihkkhuuli-c/)

| Have you considered converting a pre-tax retirement account into a Roth account as you approach retirement? Converting pre-tax retirement accounts such as IRAs to after-tax Roth IRAs could allow you to keep growing funds tax-free and then make withdrawals in retirement without paying taxes. Is this the right retirement savings strategy for you? To find out, it could be a good idea to [speak with a financial advisor.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24317%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xBeVmnbRbTGLO0U5d%2bggTg&sysid=1) Research suggests people who work with a financial advisor feel more at ease about their finances and could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1 A 2022 Northwestern Mutual study found that 62% of U.S. adults admit their financial planning needs improvement. However, only 35% of Americans work with a financial advisor.2
### **Roth IRA Conversion Basics**
The difference between a Roth IRA and other types of IRAs is that the Roth account is funded with after-tax dollars. That means you pay taxes on funds before contributing them to the Roth, and you can’t deduct contributions from your taxable income. However, the money in the Roth account grows tax-free and you can withdraw funds after you retire without paying taxes. You can convert funds in pre-tax IRA accounts to a Roth IRA. This includes traditional IRAs, SEP IRAs and Simple IRAs. When you convert pre-tax money in a regular IRA to a Roth IRA, you have to pay taxes on it at your current rate. The conversion amount is treated as regular income, which can bump you into a higher tax bracket and cause a high tax bill for the conversion year.

Despite the tax bill, a Roth IRA conversion can be worth it for a couple of reasons. [Learn about the potential benefits here.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24318%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kVEkGECQnmkuM%2bIci6nSmQ&sysid=1)

Deciding whether or not to convert regular IRA assets to a Roth IRA calls for careful evaluation of your financial and tax situation. That’s where a [financial advisor](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24319%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wvL5sqhx71%2fL0Erulbgo8g&sysid=1) can be invaluable. Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

A Weak U.S. President Leads to Death and Chaos Around the World By Colonel Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
There is a reason that U.S. Presidents are referred to as "The Leader of the Free World" because they are. A strong President can lead the world to peace and prosperity. A weak President, like Joe Biden, leads the world to death and chaos. Just look at what has happened in less than three years since Biden took office:

* A disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan killed 24 Americans and left billions of dollars of modern weapons in the hands of terrorists.

* With no fear of a strong American response, Russia invaded Ukraine. Thousands have already died as the ground war continues with no end in sight.

* A renewed Axis of Evil is forming with Russia, China, Iran, North Korea, and terrorist organizations.

* Biden's open border policies have created chaos and havoc at our southern border, attracting international terrorists from across the globe. What mayhem are they planning?

And now, Israel.
Hundreds of terrorists crossed the border of Israel to indiscriminately kill people and take hostages. Less than a month after Biden paid a ransom for American hostages, we now have more Americans held hostage.
It appears that our National Intelligence Community was asleep at the switch. Just a few days before Hamas launched their killing spree, National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan bragged that our National Security team is spending less time in the Middle East. Our Military leadership, too occupied with woke ideologies, has lost focus on protecting America.
Hamas is solely responsible for their brutal acts of terror. Israel has an absolute right to defend itself and its borders. So does the United States.
Palestinian children living in Gaza are innocent. Their parents should replace Hamas with a government that cares for them and offers freedom and prosperity. This will require courage and action, much like the American Revolution, when men and women fought to replace a repressive monarch with a government by the people and for the people.
We have got to end this dive into death and chaos. The 2024 election allows us to reverse course. We must replace the failed government of Biden with strong leaders who take firm and principled action. Dina Titus has been "ridin with Biden" for too long. She needs to go! America has always been a land of hope. For many, that hope is dimming. We can change the direction of our nation and replace chaos and despair with peace, hope, and prosperity.
*****

Colonel Mark Robertson is the only ACTUAL VETERAN in Nevada's First Congressional District race. Mark served 30 years in the Army, including Afghanistan, Iraq, and Kuwait combat zones. Now that Islamic extremists have attacked Israel, we need Colonel Robertson's experience in Washington. He is once again ready to answer the call of duty.

## Global Protests Grow Over Gaza War
Mideast tensions flared Wednesday, with [hundreds protesting in the U.S. Capitol](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOpDAQRL_GZEbtxuAhIJiEbC69EBncQN8ZG9neQbtfv2LjTeqVVEnp_X1NL8uew_bHHjSUNU52KfymSYFUvcRm0pUbViKkpqJBdb0xCNiqah9wVq3Ratatdo8FCDoDxhlolXHQtlTxgICNAtVD32ptauiXHpoZVf-YO0AQGshxian-FzmUnVb_Gd-U6iUelR_2Us4smqfAUeB4XVd95HBvAkcK8iMLHANdN87oufBy1zmR_c9hk2eKhXKJKcs7D7nYk0v0cmfv5cVll7MNgVKWNjjp6LjBOVnycrNfVi5kM62cSOBok3w-FedLPao0uPNi7zl3RmjYDsv-53P5XeF3AAAA___4NXPn) and outside the White House, leading to dozens of arrests. The protestors belonged to a Jewish group calling for a ceasefire. In Beirut, rioters battled with Lebanese security officials near the U.S. Embassy, [protesting President Biden's visit](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOozAQQL_GdIPsgZi4oEhDcVKuvRINZgCfjI1sJ4j9-lW23uoVr3l6_57jk5x3Yf1LO_dliSPZ4t48KgnKADZjW839wozcVNwrbboOJd5UtfVaYTeh0QvNVkrDRNi21GmtTTM396lyPUpslFRGmlvbdrU01shmQmXuk5YoRSt5diWm-n90oWy8-Cu-OdU27pXvt1KOLJqHwEHgcJ5nvefwcQIHDvDKAofA5wdnTH4WOBwpFs6FUwYXwPNEIQaY2abLhRVW-iLYYj5cIQ-Tp1zAesobnK5skNm-kisXLDFZzhCYErwy8D5RzpfAgRI8Hsrl7o-sUj8fp_PeZd2JVq47Of9TXn4f-R0AAP__bd12tg) and his support of Israel after the bombing of a hospital in Gaza that killed hundreds. U.S. intelligence officials said their review of the evidence [supported Israel's claim ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71uxCAQBp8GOqxl8Q8UFGncXdqUFuD1eSN8nGx0TvL0kVOn-ZpPmtF83KZb4MyP-3vYyNelTCFVftGkQWmn0EytnP1ChGQked27YUDATsvVR6JkrU1LpOiw63U_x9QZax0Y7RaU7BHQaNAOXNe2QwMuOTARtbOxBwTRAs1cy958Fn7UlZb8XV60N6lsMvu11uchzJvAUeB4nmcTvrgc1ytwvNgCRw3XWIFj5Jke6h5-glrL8eQasuJjD5RVqSvtqlLY5O7n58k589EPooX7Fjj_-er_-b8BAAD__-zQWgo)that the bombing was caused by a faulty rocket fired by Hamas, and [Israeli TV footage](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQAL8GOiN7beBcuHjNdffalGiBBTYxGNmrI8nXR5c67UwzmrfH8ECOfKz_cacgSxpwEn7SYLQyXoEdXD2HhQjI1hRM5_seNLSm3gJZ1_ZgbNfZyc6ObHtrjafRt_0CGkzNATRYo43XvnWub7SfvLYjGH8bOw26cppmlpSb98SHbLTEr_Sk3Expr2PYRM5S2X8V3Cu4X9fVLOnzoKu8_IukHOcK7lwyUmQlT7WkJLiSwvMkzEWVLV1qxW9UWyonC0Y1RiyiJtxJnRipCB-Mh8pp-iCpc5jPi2Pk0vWV0-uOHH9z5O87PwEAAP__Phdn5Q) appeared to show the errant Hamas missile striking the hospital.
## Amazon Drops Drugs by Drone
Amazon launched a test of [prescription drug delivery by drone](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1urDAQRp8GOlbjwRhP4eI22-1tUyKDx7sTGYyMxSp5-ojU6b6f5uh8PKaHlyTb879f2dWYJ79UOXlS0CnqsJ90G1xkRu5bdsrQOCLgoNqX88aqHk2kqKwPGiLHISiiEYZoNfhWHAL2ChQBDVqPN6CFoJ9RkZ0NIDQaOEjN5faZZasvjukrn1xuS17b5F617kfT_2vw3uDd7xu_j-u6SqmyJL7S6r_z1oWSNz66vfCxFNmrXBsnObkIHx3jYGetbEQLBsgGVnH2agRDM0XWbXFhf0tKcpix0fBcvaRfjPq3lZ8AAAD__8a4YhE) in College Station, Texas, allowing delivery within an hour of placing an order. The company has tested general drone deliveries before, but never for medicine. The drone will fly from a delivery center with a secure pharmacy to the customer's address, descend to a height of about 13 feet, and then [literally drop the padded package](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFv8yAQgOFfgzes44xxGBi-xVu-taNF4BxTYWPBKWn666t07vwOj_R-XJerTzkd9_9-J8drWXzg9KBFgVRW4rDoLrqVCGnoyCljpwkBR9VtjnQwJlyCj2YaaSCr42gnAzreFBpvu-QQcFCgLNhR66kHGywMN1T2cjOAIDRQTFxq_1nSwRut-VUeVPtQ9i67jflsYvgncBY4M4Xt68yl0jsLnA96NoHz25AKpN_9dzlkrOWgJs9KLdR0cipHk7GU2phOmRNT9Tm_-o333FUXz2fKOTUzCQ333af8i_PfL34CAAD__3SmYR8) to the ground. Amazon says customers can choose from more than 500 medications, including common treatments for the flu and pneumonia, but not controlled substances.
## What's Hot and Not for Halloween Candy
Spending on Halloween candy is expected to hit $3.6 billion this month, a 16% jump from the previous high of $3.1 billion. name: Margaret Mary Dunn
subject: Life in prison for doing his job
body:
Will you help my son?

I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas.

_**But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck.**_

[**Will you help my son?**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=635de375403c4ce982a1e6910f43b4ee&_e=kZK4XZNZgJG2k29eX35NTUyf7myUfnaTAHM7L57_4o84TRw-9pWE32MaS92CUzR2lNyaGL_ns-DzCYOoM3EPu2NvLj62q60RJ3A6SrjSIzSEX15VJQAzudLOa-JVIA4ImWLK3IxC1sN68gDUSURrF3-X9kgyOnxHUg6ubiAx7lGLrC29hUvIDTTgOE1Aj4KJQXiZ5BoWaYcFbeqjmRFFHoFmH9EnVR_Or81hCesWxueMksdUtUWhylg3K17hzX-zBVoIWy4YE0zd3Aw-PHe5hQTqkgyNXB1MMzdreKqm5jFrGCzRrR-9UnpiVeyrJuwCFboe_wTpmOokmAOdEH-JqQLnYGFSjbnwRIosBVXNa8c%3D)

That's Michael in the photo.

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=635de375403c4ce982a1e6910f43b4ee&_e=kZK4XZNZgJG2k29eX35NTUyf7myUfnaTAHM7L57_4o84TRw-9pWE32MaS92CUzR2lNyaGL_ns-DzCYOoM3EPu2NvLj62q60RJ3A6SrjSIzSEX15VJQAzudLOa-JVIA4ImWLK3IxC1sN68gDUSURrF3-X9kgyOnxHUg6ubiAx7lGLrC29hUvIDTTgOE1Aj4KJcAMTvJ8lfRU52XR5uawgfSUz1lArerNd398l6_LB9cX3O7mb31OyGplrdPArUEvynSDUs3iJBb12IQy0EKNhW_m0ZCdJFz4ik94lp0Gr5nVSKvF3bTtsDItPTemsfrM5f-lAp9sI3J8e6olxbT6Q0ECLbot-vDsYP6qWpC6WrVs%3D) [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=635de375403c4ce982a1e6910f43b4ee&_e=kZK4XZNZgJG2k29eX35NTUyf7myUfnaTAHM7L57_4o84TRw-9pWE32MaS92CUzR2lNyaGL_ns-DzCYOoM3EPu2NvLj62q60RJ3A6SrjSIzSEX15VJQAzudLOa-JVIA4ImWLK3IxC1sN68gDUSURrF3-X9kgyOnxHUg6ubiAx7lGLrC29hUvIDTTgOE1Aj4KJiqdAETrYSqWkVHfkbPqif1MJXvwCybkGG8hufI3yNMLtzvbydii9JuvwgkwYqBIDve9xdb8EQevRV6URy6mYlxKl6Q2DBVPyAbW0GMEpcoBLyr_xGkf8FSUrYaOI0Iqq3EAZ830ko6o2dLpC2laSwyoZl_Wt1fh1LOs1ahZ8zbg%3D)

In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve.

I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job.

Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty.

It's been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years.

What I didn't expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need.

I now realize that it's all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist.

Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats.

Fear of losing their jobs.

I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back.

**But I was wrong.**

_So_ _now_ _Michael 's_ _life_ _is_ _at_ _stake_ _for_ _simply_ _doing_ _his_ _job_ _and_ _we_ _have_ _nobody_ _to_ _turn_ _to_ _except_ _for_ _good_ _hearted_ _strangers_ _like_ _you._

**[Will you please help me save my son Michael?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=635de375403c4ce982a1e6910f43b4ee&_e=kZK4XZNZgJG2k29eX35NTUyf7myUfnaTAHM7L57_4o84TRw-9pWE32MaS92CUzR2lNyaGL_ns-DzCYOoM3EPu2NvLj62q60RJ3A6SrjSIzSEX15VJQAzudLOa-JVIA4ImWLK3IxC1sN68gDUSURrF3-X9kgyOnxHUg6ubiAx7lGLrC29hUvIDTTgOE1Aj4KJnL8o6EJbeOwJ2EfRcjPNI6XgPP3ivOZUPVbGaRv_22pzW8z4CYi9EKeTJFy2CCW5Ci_fONMApdSNz7U0oL9KzZ5J8xjExXTshE4Uqf20Vt1w-dR2rcCPxS7QQeMwiXBg40b-4Xuy61m-KdyHbkm9OioA7BHDY4wND134FFio9e4%3D)**

Let me give you some more of the details...

Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade."

The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police.

Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man.

When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car.

The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him.

Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired.

The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene.

My son suffered back and leg injuries.

Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck.

In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community.

There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day.

He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others.

But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years.

Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did?

That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. **[Even if that means asking folks like you for financial support to help my son afford the best possible attorneys and legal advice.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=635de375403c4ce982a1e6910f43b4ee&_e=kZK4XZNZgJG2k29eX35NTUyf7myUfnaTAHM7L57_4o84TRw-9pWE32MaS92CUzR2lNyaGL_ns-DzCYOoM3EPu2NvLj62q60RJ3A6SrjSIzSEX15VJQAzudLOa-JVIA4ImWLK3IxC1sN68gDUSURrF3-X9kgyOnxHUg6ubiAx7lGLrC29hUvIDTTgOE1Aj4KJwEkQ7XTkYbL1A4RVUZTevcBt0KVFk856gH_K-i6ByLUOUC-cps5CPnXLgTcIR64M7x9IeY7mPct9demQsjHibbKFhG2bC8HDXkiR4syj_FIiXO-c9sOamF1pdPjegjwwYlsnuzUj5BPwJbkQHSzJLQ4xmvi-AxPnQ5iKLB5sKHA%3D)**

After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died.

But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified.

And then our whole world was rocked.

**Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted.**

Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said:

"We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never."

I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court.

We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense.

After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser.

They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" - and helping him violated their terms of service.

So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds.

No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process.

Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime."

Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael.

_With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading._

Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). **LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have.**

LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.

The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.

And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son!

**[Will you please consider sending a tax-deductible contribution to the LELDF so they can help my son beat his charges?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=635de375403c4ce982a1e6910f43b4ee&_e=kZK4XZNZgJG2k29eX35NTUyf7myUfnaTAHM7L57_4o84TRw-9pWE32MaS92CUzR2lNyaGL_ns-DzCYOoM3EPu2NvLj62q60RJ3A6SrjSIzSEX15VJQAzudLOa-JVIA4ImWLK3IxC1sN68gDUSURrF3-X9kgyOnxHUg6ubiAx7lGLrC29hUvIDTTgOE1Aj4KJ_-IQp7eITJHfd8lAUsTWbltMw0g0_AKvavHhXgwfb0WRdEwEk8a-fopw09Fae9uRp1UDDV48Kr-8tCUBAP8x0LwSio3-KFD1xjZjKLS6cks1394hONN8Sp9T1uCmBa9cfo4B84tFllsTtbo8dIyaNGsRQoJ_-6-w-CSciLJ_KF4%3D)**

You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers.

Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a **[gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more,](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=635de375403c4ce982a1e6910f43b4ee&_e=kZK4XZNZgJG2k29eX35NTUyf7myUfnaTAHM7L57_4o84TRw-9pWE32MaS92CUzR2lNyaGL_ns-DzCYOoM3EPu2NvLj62q60RJ3A6SrjSIzSEX15VJQAzudLOa-JVIA4ImWLK3IxC1sN68gDUSURrF3-X9kgyOnxHUg6ubiAx7lGLrC29hUvIDTTgOE1Aj4KJNqx1xDkbHGzw-Zwa_Fk6LoIiJURa6S61iJnViASOUzDQWp8rO3ZRdYav1ia4DQg5UVHHIAQK8vCAtJVNzY1EcVk1Ff1nJtmhoEknn5U_40iLUxHsiWIfinXiN0S73XtPtza12p2rZg0SUjHM_wHoo4aKQj8JqVYTdHm24utgERQ%3D)** I pray you will consider doing so.

Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing.

If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers.

My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal.
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=635de375403c4ce982a1e6910f43b4ee&_e=kZK4XZNZgJG2k29eX35NTUyf7myUfnaTAHM7L57_4o84TRw-9pWE32MaS92CUzR2lNyaGL_ns-DzCYOoM3EPu2NvLj62q60RJ3A6SrjSIzSEX15VJQAzudLOa-JVIA4ImWLK3IxC1sN68gDUSURrF3-X9kgyOnxHUg6ubiAx7lGLrC29hUvIDTTgOE1Aj4KJLFE-2zWHDCZhpa7VezTImvwk--BOrMSL9_kTNyFNax1T1aWPhxpF4X-3DJX1JP4NHRH1baePDJmVTottYg_4fcZGaLI3li5TwxnYiRZvVLUoFeXB6y2BZBUnvduMSzVgHnYMiwJlRkN1a75JlGxZY0GpHvo_OBi3O6w_aAHnyKk%3D)
_That's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn_

_That's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William_

I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today.

Sincerely,

Margaret Mary Dunn

Miami Beach Republican State Representative Fabián Basabe (R-106) just filed HB 93 to EXPAND abortion in Florida – allowing preborn little boys and girls to be killed up to 12 weeks of a pregnancy.

And these betrayals by the Republican party are only going to get worse if we don’t do something about it!

**[So, could you please CLICK HERE to take this brief poll and let me know if you think Republicans should stand strong for LIFE – and protect babies with beating hearts from the violence of abortion](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-swhltk-duchtdja-y/)?**

**[And then, would you please consider chipping in $100, $50, $25, or even $10 to help us send a LOUD-AND-CLEAR message to Rep. Basabe right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-swhltk-duchtdja-j/)?**

name: Spike Cohen
subject: Just say “No” to government
body:
When the government shuts down our businesses and lives for COVID,

[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=83fd6fadf363492cbc2cfff172dce5eb&_e=t1KhqZDO_A3afT9gUNlrYCShwEfPCuwkRmzJYVajF2lk542mTsEJLuAlhA6CglHtvdPYeq39mX63gkocbkvmwtVLGl0prXOz6JLPGv95_iUKsvFWNiOGbFp8tnTVwu_f1x_ETXVl30UHKZFBGgGQbRLNWvtb2woPfVphd76DUFSkZ9gnRfscdRDv4YTwsfVw1DK46ByeFdITqdpc_uqpejZpVinaDYBuSyDenr3tF4Fffv58hIZwsSOzFCD2AIZn6o6W0-Fx6Tnk6lKl8-u4l7FlOSFR9HuGZxEWbeOMZFU%3D)

Friend,

In the 20th century, you were more likely to be killed by your own government than by a foreign government.

Not all of these deaths were obvious acts of evil, like the Nazi Holocaust. Many were from starvation, like under the Soviet Union. When you get into the numbers, it becomes impossible to comprehend - hundreds of millions killed and, in many cases, murdered.

**Let me be clear** \- The government is still the single biggest cause of death and human suffering in the 21st century.

_My vision is to teach the next generation to "just say no" to the government_.

_When the government shuts down our businesses and lives for COVID, we need a populace to "just say no."_

_When the government spies on its citizens and conducts no-knock nighttime raids on their homes, we need to "just say no."_

_When the government stands in the way of your kids being murdered in a school shooting, we need to "just say no."_

_When the government refuses to respect you as an individual human being, we need to "just say no."_

But this is much more than just a vision. I launched my organization, You Are The Power, to fight for that individual human respect, and one of our greatest partners in this fight has been Students For Liberty.

**Students For Liberty (SFL) is an international pro-liberty organization focused on spreading the message of liberty, capitalism, entrepreneurship, and training young people with leadership skills ... This organization is changing the world and making liberty popular with young people.**

[SFL has been there for me, so I want to help them raise $25,000 online. I am emailing my supporters with a humble request. Can you please chip in $10, $35, or even $100 today to support SFL? Click here to donate >>](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=83fd6fadf363492cbc2cfff172dce5eb&_e=t1KhqZDO_A3afT9gUNlrYCShwEfPCuwkRmzJYVajF2lk542mTsEJLuAlhA6CglHtvdPYeq39mX63gkocbkvmwtVLGl0prXOz6JLPGv95_iUKsvFWNiOGbFp8tnTVwu_f1x_ETXVl30UHKZFBGgGQba0fkf-WgYfb-c16VgO5skUS6TwaikwDK2rapTIFvtotNtWuzeuCW5We2ZvEq8EB9tWJTit9XMj2LuEbuOm8pkSSc_xbrqKjEtSv24ZHcby7-c8_1CW-EtgCMP-6EMsHi-dFjRoQ-sAdLluGrfoLXzw%3D)

[Donate](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=83fd6fadf363492cbc2cfff172dce5eb&_e=t1KhqZDO_A3afT9gUNlrYCShwEfPCuwkRmzJYVajF2lk542mTsEJLuAlhA6CglHtvdPYeq39mX63gkocbkvmwtVLGl0prXOz6JLPGv95_iUKsvFWNiOGbFp8tnTVwu_f1x_ETXVl30UHKZFBGgGQbZ_zCdUkUMPVywe-q-AOFv2aZb_pIbF8vC05ognMe2uVPE_TmplJ7O1Hb7DUhobZ5y4wfp40ssfHCqFPscPfJaifXjE5TuPhMt5xZ-u1rHGhbkxufnFoXEHO_FdwgR7862VlhLnotG0f6f01HYMR_5I%3D)

**Why Students For Liberty?**

In one year, SFL had 157k student attendees at their conferences. SFL students had over 482,572 volunteer hours in building freedom in their communities on campuses and across the world. And last year alone, they had over 6 million views in the vital 18-24 year old demographic.

Students For Liberty isn't taking an election-by-election approach. SFL shares a long-term vision with me, building up student leaders who will become our future leaders.

You Are The Power has partnered with SFL in student activism workshops from Ohio to Australia, and we're just getting started.

And that's just the beginning of what they're doing:

_In the United States, SFL students are on the front lines defending gun rights, and they are activists behind the growing success of the school choice movement._

_In Africa, SFL is on the front lines, promoting civil liberties and even helping to stop genocide against Christian minorities._

_In China, SFL activists organized the White Paper Protest against the censorship of the Chinese Communist Party._

Our country and the world are on the brink of a new revolution. The age of the internet changed everything. And government tyrants are clamping down on our freedoms because they are losing control.

**This is our moment to demand that the government respect each and every one of us.**

I am asking for your immediate support to help Students For Liberty raise the next generation of pro-liberty leaders across the world. This is not an exaggeration. They have former SFL students running for office all across Latin America.

clean_body: When the government shuts down our businesses and lives for COVID, Friend, In the 20th century, you were more likely to be killed by your own government than by a foreign government. Not all of these deaths were obvious acts of evil, like the Nazi Holocaust. Many were from starvation, like under the Soviet Union. When you get into the numbers, it becomes impossible to comprehend - hundreds of millions killed and, in many cases, murdered. Let me be clear \- The government is still the single biggest cause of death and human suffering in the 21st century. My vision is to teach the next generation to "just say no" to the government. When the government shuts down our businesses and lives for COVID, we need a populace to "just say no." When the government spies on its citizens and conducts no-knock nighttime raids on their homes, we need to "just say no." When the government stands in the way of your kids being murdered in a school shooting, we need to "just say no." When the government refuses to respect you as an individual human being, we need to "just say no." But this is much more than just a vision. I launched my organization, You Are The Power, to fight for that individual human respect, and one of our greatest partners in this fight has been Students For Liberty. Students For Liberty (SFL) is an international pro-liberty organization focused on spreading the message of liberty, capitalism, entrepreneurship, and training young people with leadership skills ... This organization is changing the world and making liberty popular with young people. Why Students For Liberty? In one year, SFL had 157k student attendees at their conferences. SFL students had over 482,572 volunteer hours in building freedom in their communities on campuses and across the world. And last year alone, they had over 6 million views in the vital 18-24 year old demographic. Students For Liberty isn't taking an election-by-election approach. SFL shares a long-term vision with me, building up student leaders who will become our future leaders. You Are The Power has partnered with SFL in student activism workshops from Ohio to Australia, and we're just getting started. And that's just the beginning of what they're doing: In the United States, SFL students are on the front lines defending gun rights, and they are activists behind the growing success of the school choice movement. In Africa, SFL is on the front lines, promoting civil liberties and even helping to stop genocide against Christian minorities. In China, SFL activists organized the White Paper Protest against the censorship of the Chinese Communist Party. Our country and the world are on the brink of a new revolution. The age of the internet changed everything. And government tyrants are clamping down on our freedoms because they are losing control. This is our moment to demand that the government respect each and every one of us. I am asking for your immediate support to help Students For Liberty raise the next generation of pro-liberty leaders across the world. This is not an exaggeration. They have former SFL students running for office all across Latin America. You can be the reason for the next Frederic Bastiat, Ron Paul, or Ayn Rand. It is vital for us to reach students during their developing years if we are to build a new generation of pro-liberty leaders. I am counting on you. body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock or scare you - I say it because it's true. _What we see today didn 't happen overnight. It's the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **... and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I'd know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ - radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan - then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I've dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn't tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That's why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** - and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I'm asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=877dca518eab47a29b52250eb664bda1&_e=vH_gByCdF9_pNCpvJzoA2W8HcFXcN076zjQ02wfhruQNmcS7Mb9AhXJEz2mPE8D1QWNJMc5UusicQj_f3rMvQUnSRqWwCT5QMu95yRoqszj4MLWRjZE8JbX8zap81oEC7lqOOH7BlM2RGInYhYRqBXTLTFC7eiWI9QkkgxKdX4usjOyFMRQWqNW4KGOa04DI34krKP0P8lSHQs0qQoMLww6ZYCZKbQLxbNiMDcJIEaunZIkAF4rZLdmZl8gf9UIL3rbkxGXOftO0QNGfSIRtvv5VG0lWw_yKPE_OeZeK-vuXnBfKfahLG5WW4NqdqgTdZ8cye7KfVT5p9wLvVF3cwdNhVMfgAebQ6c-tKK-T8ph5MrNdY3H8JdrGTmFsir_tObY7S4cvJA2W0rgQio35Sw%3D%3D)** When you think of "the enemy within" you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn't be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we've seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making - but most of the American people have no clue what we're up against. **That 's why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state - and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as "white supremacists" and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... "A Great Book" - Dinesh D'Souza "_The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life." - Mark Levin "David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation." Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within -- and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We've reached the point in our history that will decide our future - and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That's why I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=877dca518eab47a29b52250eb664bda1&_e=vH_gByCdF9_pNCpvJzoA2W8HcFXcN076zjQ02wfhruQNmcS7Mb9AhXJEz2mPE8D1QWNJMc5UusicQj_f3rMvQUnSRqWwCT5QMu95yRoqszj4MLWRjZE8JbX8zap81oEC7lqOOH7BlM2RGInYhYRqBXTLTFC7eiWI9QkkgxKdX4usjOyFMRQWqNW4KGOa04DI34krKP0P8lSHQs0qQoMLww6ZYCZKbQLxbNiMDcJIEaunZIkAF4rZLdmZl8gf9UILqqg-JPPCEbJgGUoDnXV1H1HwxBRLtuA7l_tE8SvueSgx2M5qUA2ejdrzGIoEIoc5NZ-Xr6yb-U84G5NNnMqINHdX4oSvxIwFQbxTg2-PjDkTNohVevzKPqCnhIWDlShzYl5aJilbxuj7qytX9YfT8w%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don't simply disagree with us about how to make our country better - they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama's own words "radically transform" America. **And they don 't care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it's up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

| | Dear Fellow American,

As we witness increased efforts to strip America's classrooms of civic education, rewrite our nation's history, and stifle important debates, the need for informed citizens is urgent and obvious.

Our Founders understood this when they established our free nation. In his Farewell Address, George Washington stressed that "virtue or morality is the necessary spring of popular government" and that "it is essential that public opinion should be enlightened."

Without a firm grasp of the Constitution and America's founding principles, we cannot stand firm against the threats facing the nation today.

That's why Hillsdale College invites all Americans to take this FREE online course: "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution."

In this self-paced course, you'll:

* Understand the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty.
* Explore how our Founders shaped the freest government in human history.
* Examine the challenges our form of government has faced over the past century and the threats we confront today.

After completing this course, you'll understand why our Founders built the greatest nation in human history and why we must preserve it.

Follow this secure link to start the first lecture with Dr. Larry P. Arnn within minutes:

[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/constitution-101](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=66099c448b254d3696f2d368dbc595ed&_e=15A-ly4H7fQ0RMCj11H2AX-gSsGbT60Og_LkLHMK4uq73GNgUMHb9OmHbOm6Qcc6Kjx9zRafviK1VUYLPJAO2V_o7IdQdJXHg50sbEA-4aEw2ZaLQLJECSdHedbPHM-WhWDRQiMAI_kkh6oSRq8gHjeip5u5c-VGZSppRMdA3Ux3e0xWlRrf2GOVHIdHPygX8FI-dD3fbY0JK5LcCYCjzc9l2Eq7zHL-x-hhDSmCrBkydsGG9BrVbAuHaUoHi8jel5ko57MZ2smMKfrLWVky_as2N8RgHoasB_1PUwokD50KrORecYnfPS_07-uF9U-uUtjh4ZxA5doS0r0_UcPu75nFgtiTIOXAMvD_GNeUEcXuuTo5VBRjoWPbuwsj6kx8599Gn0uK4oNUomrtwFKx9A%3D%3D)

---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Stop a potential catastrophic OIL SPILL in the Gulf of Mexico!** Picture this: a sunset melting into the ocean horizon. A beautiful white-sand beach -- or at least it used to be. Now, the shore is coated black. The once-blue water shimmers with dirty oil. Dead marine animals wash onto the beach: poisoned sea turtles and drowned sea birds. Oil spills impact people living by the shore too. Fumes cause **breathing complications.** Fish die-offs **devastate coastal economies.** Immeasurable loss, Friend. The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management is planning three new lease sales to let Big Oil drill in the Gulf of Mexico, risking another spill. We need **4,309 more signatures before the comment deadline to reach our goal!** [**Help cancel offshore lease sales in the Gulf of Mexico! Send your message now! >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2059638?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2059639?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
These lease sales include **critical habitat for the endangered Rice’s whale** with only an estimated **51 whales remaining on Earth!** Offshore seismic blasting from oil rigs interrupts their sonar and the ship traffic increases risk of striking and killing these poor creatures.
Don’t let Big Oil hurt communities and wildlife in the Gulf. You can help us prevent another catastrophic oil spill. But, Friend, we’re running out of time! **[Send your message to the Bureau of Ocean Energy Management and help STOP Big Oil from drilling in our oceans before it’s too late!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2059640?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**

Raena Garcia

Media For Handling Of Debates - American Update

North Dakota Gov. Doug Burgum criticized the Republican National
Committee’s (RNC’s) debate criteria and the corporate media’s handling

I have written a book

| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9efec6420ae84f38b48d4b4722f87e0a&_e=rpWCicANO-QXKJavfmwlDHcaH3VqSOCKWihwMvmo4D18tg9fs0ayj95GRsiwnLMuwgLCbtdo4YKo1-Z6LPesYNugGKoxVa7iccE-ewcJidcW4R3rt4fyYkT-CeV0fL3RNyuo2UlwjBdeDA2AhW4ukts9dYvVNjbjAMkRhMtQwgPkVkPFlDwZLrMm8Ntt7xH8loX2Ua782HHmIxLmsRHV4VNXkw5K6LjhriLBxwJmagu3UEnmX7sNgtFFG86bPQ3r2rlcGQrlUKWnIzsahvFFYa05mD8NuL2x6F2QweKwOLq1ZW3vlql3jRXBLU1Ay6K-b6wPb2GwEjKHCxv4_4euUeIJlGyQuTwekeevn7zuxRycKEZDmf-LZwOOpA3qvaAtMojR7_1egPJCfRZTQnUh7upicQo-mKwCt1EybPuSpTw%3D)

| Fellow American,

Are you worried about the rising influence of radical ideologies in today's schools? I know I am.

That's why I have created the Little Patriots Program. This program provides curriculum for grades K-5 that teaches the REAL history of America, promoting the values of faith, liberty, community, and life that made our nation great.

This innovative approach makes learning history fun for our children while instilling in them a profound love and respect for our country. [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9efec6420ae84f38b48d4b4722f87e0a&_e=rpWCicANO-QXKJavfmwlDHcaH3VqSOCKWihwMvmo4D18tg9fs0ayj95GRsiwnLMuwgLCbtdo4YKo1-Z6LPesYNugGKoxVa7iccE-ewcJidcW4R3rt4fyYkT-CeV0fL3RNyuo2UlwjBdeDA2AhW4ukts9dYvVNjbjAMkRhMtQwgPkVkPFlDwZLrMm8Ntt7xH8loX2Ua782HHmIxLmsRHV4VNXkw5K6LjhriLBxwJmagu3UEnmX7sNgtFFG86bPQ3rgVEcWRPUgYpKEhaXNahviiEPGvotGte02pi6Uxt7qGzQNP8mf3l1rUTFDOw1K9d1rjibImpuWrNzPJt2RAVy-F5-hRNeVeq2tv5jWycvgYDsNJzrP3p0Wk5UFuFrqR3sZuj8yizzDaEq-1cE8nBLfJ8dLaq5bdC4E30UP5hal_I%3D) But, in order to keep this curriculum **free of charge** , I need your support.

I have written a book, [_Why America Matters_.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9efec6420ae84f38b48d4b4722f87e0a&_e=rpWCicANO-QXKJavfmwlDHcaH3VqSOCKWihwMvmo4D18tg9fs0ayj95GRsiwnLMuwgLCbtdo4YKo1-Z6LPesYNugGKoxVa7iccE-ewcJidcW4R3rt4fyYkT-CeV0fL3RNyuo2UlwjBdeDA2AhW4ukts9dYvVNjbjAMkRhMtQwgPkVkPFlDwZLrMm8Ntt7xH8loX2Ua782HHmIxLmsRHV4VNXkw5K6LjhriLBxwJmagu3UEnmX7sNgtFFG86bPQ3rrUOUB3xLqn2C9vep6bQOGNpc-eS4smPfoNXV79eSm2FUTC7-8nph5JrQMreqZzI6uIAfKh3upL4r1NFeZAA85oKBaukh_iSYBNbDHFae6mLSSMmGLAaDAZ0MFITC3ZZnw9YdFW_SherlA_4WWfz_zHSVDsKWSHfoVJkE-uozNK4%3D) Intended for young readers, this book creates a deeper understanding of the importance of our country and the respect that it deserves.

I want to send you a copy for a gift of $25 or more. To give a gift use this secure link: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/why-america-matters-donate](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9efec6420ae84f38b48d4b4722f87e0a&_e=rpWCicANO-QXKJavfmwlDHcaH3VqSOCKWihwMvmo4D18tg9fs0ayj95GRsiwnLMuwgLCbtdo4YKo1-Z6LPesYNugGKoxVa7iccE-ewcJidcW4R3rt4fyYkT-CeV0fL3RNyuo2UlwjBdeDA2AhW4ukts9dYvVNjbjAMkRhMtQwgPkVkPFlDwZLrMm8Ntt7xH8loX2Ua782HHmIxLmsRHV4VNXkw5K6LjhriLBxwJmagu3UEnmX7sNgtFFG86bPQ3r2StBwRG71GayvGxr4pgpgzIeg1VRBF9qcWv4bj5sarHSUXq8ed54ouKfuebK0rFgZVhtP1mVWoS8G2LxZHuow0chOUrxE6CXLrg6ofBiZxJ5azX-YVLesT4YwYimsFWKXH5fkwVbQo3D7d_l1cXkU3qplzZbX2t3vF0STQqIQiw%3D)

All proceeds from your donation will go directly to supporting our Little Patriots Program, ensuring that we can keep creating curricula and cartoons that show the history of America.

You can help shape the minds of our future leaders today and give them the best possible resources.

Your gift of $25 or more will get you access to my book, _Why America Matters_ , and help us reach more children with the truth.

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

name: Pro Life Update
subject: Deepen your understanding of the Constitution
body:
Hillsdale College invites all Americans to take this FREE online course

| This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z1r8reu8sp0bk5d9805mrrkn6o71r84q4bgh1tno_rp22sh2s8i66p77ctj60pj2cth2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

As we witness increased efforts to strip America's classrooms of civic education, rewrite our nation's history, and stifle important debates, the need for informed citizens is urgent and obvious.

Our Founders understood this when they established our free nation. In his Farewell Address, George Washington stressed that "virtue or morality is the necessary spring of popular government" and that "it is essential that public opinion should be enlightened."

Without a firm grasp of the Constitution and America's founding principles, we cannot stand firm against the threats facing the nation today.

That's why Hillsdale College invites all Americans to take this FREE online course: "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution."

In this self-paced course, you'll:

* Understand the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty.
* Explore how our Founders shaped the freest government in human history.
* Examine the challenges our form of government has faced over the past century and the threats we confront today.

After completing this course, you'll understand why our Founders built the greatest nation in human history and why we must preserve it.

Follow this secure link to start the first lecture with Dr. Larry P. Arnn within minutes:

[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/constitution-101](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp356qoiodopmkubvd60qvbekhimgq88qh4j2v8g_rp22sh2s8i66p77ctj60pj2cth2bs)

Warm regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09

body:
Did you see our previous email?

We have an important update about the upcoming elections. Voters will have their ballots this week!

The need to ensure voters know what's really going on in their own backyards is more critical than ever - after all, you cannot trust mainstream media outlets to cover races fairly!

**If you've already contributed, we extend our heartfelt thanks.[If not, please consider donating $100, $50, or $25 to Shift WA.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62376232:sBJ188ipN:m:1:2610672541:C26CE3B0256CE35153A7CC66BF70D88E:r)** Your contribution will help us provide more voters with essential insights into their local elections, ensuring an informed and engaged electorate.

Join us in championing transparency by contributing today.

Thank you,

The Shift WA Team
We are at a crucial moment in the 2023 election cycle! Ballots will be on their way this week, and voters across our state will begin to receive them in the mail. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62376233:sBJ188ipN:m:1:2610672541:C26CE3B0256CE35153A7CC66BF70D88E:r "Shift Washington")

|

Unfortunately, the mainstream media has demonstrated an all-too-obvious bias, often operating as a communications arm of the Democrat party. We believe in the power of informed voters. subject: Enroll in “Constitution 101” today
body:
Hillsdale College invites all Americans to take this FREE online course

| This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zirasoaj0g5kcej74e80fge1thmao3ors3hdg5ng_rp22sh2s8i66p77ctj6cp76c9h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

As we witness increased efforts to strip America's classrooms of civic education, rewrite our nation's history, and stifle important debates, the need for informed citizens is urgent and obvious.

Our Founders understood this when they established our free nation. In his Farewell Address, George Washington stressed that "virtue or morality is the necessary spring of popular government" and that "it is essential that public opinion should be enlightened."

Without a firm grasp of the Constitution and America's founding principles, we cannot stand firm against the threats facing the nation today.

That's why Hillsdale College invites all Americans to take this FREE online course: "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution."

In this self-paced course, you'll:

* Understand the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty.
* Explore how our Founders shaped the freest government in human history.
* Examine the challenges our form of government has faced over the past century and the threats we confront today.

After completing this course, you'll understand why our Founders built the greatest nation in human history and why we must preserve it.

Follow this secure link to start the first lecture with Dr. Larry P. Arnn within minutes:

[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/constitution-101](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztu4gs4rn9l2dkch3a9n64m73sr4md5ovbfit8j0_rp22sh2s8i66p77ctj6cp76c9h2bs)

Warm regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College **

body:
Jim Jordan has been in the news all week as he continues to try to become the next Speaker of the House.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=739%2E135344%2EAWpcZo)

Jim Jordan has been in the news all week as he continues to try to become the next Speaker of the House. As he demands yet another public vote on the House Floor, we thought it would be useful to break down who Jim Jordan is, by the numbers:
> **1** : Number of insurrections incited. Jordan was one of Donald Trump’s most enthusiastic henchmen in the efforts to overturn the 2020 election, and was subpoenaed by the January 6th Committee for his role as a “significant player in President Trump’s efforts to overturn the 2020 election”, and he was referred to the House Ethics Committee for investigation.
> **6** : Number of wrestlers who have come forward to say Jordan turned a deliberate blind eye to sexual assaults by his assistant wrestling coach at Ohio State. This issue is particularly sensitive in Michigan, where Larry Nasser, a gymnastics coach, was convicted of sexually assaulting over 265 women and girls while some officials turned a blind eye.
> **0** : Number of bills passed into law in his 16 years in Congress. Jim Jordan is a true culture war activist who doesn’t have a single law to show for his time representing his district.
We don’t need extremists like Jim Jordan in House leadership. At this moment in our history, and with so much going on in the world, we need principled, bipartisan leaders who will get to work on behalf of the country. [**If you agree, we’d love a contribution to Elissa’s campaign for Senate today.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct23.ttRNnI&refcode=em231019&t=2&akid=739%2E135344%2EAWpcZo)**
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct23.ttRNnI&refcode=em231019&t=3&akid=739%2E135344%2EAWpcZo)**
But the above numbers aren’t the only concerning ones. **If you pull back the curtain on one of Elissa’s potential opponents, former Congressman Mike Rogers, the numbers also tell quite a story:**
> **192** : Number of bills Mike Rogers co-sponsored together with Jim Jordan.
> **3** : Number of times Mike Rogers and Jim Jordan cosponsored legislation to enforce a federal abortion ban, in every state in the country — with zero exceptions for rape, incest or common miscarriage.
> **7** : Number of times Mike Rogers and Jim Jordan voted to privatize, and thereby cut, Medicare together, in Rogers’ 14 years in the House. So about once every year they served together.
**Here’s another number: $3.** [**That’s the amount you can contribute to help us send Elissa Slotkin to the Senate and push back against Jim Jordan and Mike Roger’s brand of extremism. Will you chip in to our campaign today?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct23.ttRNnI&refcode=em231019&t=4&akid=739%2E135344%2EAWpcZo)**

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

name: Spike Cohen
subject: Just say “No” to government
body:
When the government shuts down our businesses and lives for COVID,

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zn5h7cnjqupfig6eai7140i1e945132t93l1l4ko_rp22sh2s8i66p77ctj62o72cjh2bs)

Friend,

In the 20th century, you were more likely to be killed by your own government than by a foreign government.

Not all of these deaths were obvious acts of evil, like the Nazi Holocaust. Many were from starvation, like under the Soviet Union. When you get into the numbers, it becomes impossible to comprehend - hundreds of millions killed and, in many cases, murdered.

**Let me be clear** \- The government is still the single biggest cause of death and human suffering in the 21st century.

_My vision is to teach the next generation to "just say no" to the government_.

_When the government shuts down our businesses and lives for COVID, we need a populace to "just say no."_

_When the government spies on its citizens and conducts no-knock nighttime raids on their homes, we need to "just say no."_

_When the government stands in the way of your kids being murdered in a school shooting, we need to "just say no."_

_When the government refuses to respect you as an individual human being, we need to "just say no."_

But this is much more than just a vision. I launched my organization, You Are The Power, to fight for that individual human respect, and one of our greatest partners in this fight has been Students For Liberty.

**Students For Liberty (SFL) is an international pro-liberty organization focused on spreading the message of liberty, capitalism, entrepreneurship, and training young people with leadership skills ... This organization is changing the world and making liberty popular with young people.**

[SFL has been there for me, so I want to help them raise $25,000 online. I am emailing my supporters with a humble request. Can you please chip in $10, $35, or even $100 today to support SFL? Click here to donate >>](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2g2sabpkmuov8hq4epr6a5mbb8n9v7iq15oae78_rp22sh2s8i66p77ctj62o72cjh2bs)

[Donate](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zi9n8pvf4r2ncadakih55j5h3h9flj21p4veo2c0_rp22sh2s8i66p77ctj62o72cjh2bs)

**Why Students For Liberty?**

In one year, SFL had 157k student attendees at their conferences. SFL students had over 482,572 volunteer hours in building freedom in their communities on campuses and across the world. And last year alone, they had over 6 million views in the vital 18-24 year old demographic.

Students For Liberty isn't taking an election-by-election approach. SFL shares a long-term vision with me, building up student leaders who will become our future leaders.

You Are The Power has partnered with SFL in student activism workshops from Ohio to Australia, and we're just getting started.

And that's just the beginning of what they're doing:

_In the United States, SFL students are on the front lines defending gun rights, and they are activists behind the growing success of the school choice movement._

_In Africa, SFL is on the front lines, promoting civil liberties and even helping to stop genocide against Christian minorities._

_In China, SFL activists organized the White Paper Protest against the censorship of the Chinese Communist Party._

Our country and the world are on the brink of a new revolution. The age of the internet changed everything. And government tyrants are clamping down on our freedoms because they are losing control.

**ICYMI: John Teichert Supports Israel’s Military Strategy On Newsmax**
**Baltimore, MD** – In case you missed it, Maryland U.S. Senate candidate and retired Brigadier General John Teichert addressed Israel’s rumored military strategy of drawn out offensives against Hamas in Gaza during an appearance on Newsmax Tuesday.
[WATCH: ](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=ac2f93b56b&e=1b1fb1ad9f)

[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=6e8d320c08&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
**“Ultimately, their [IDF] primary objective is to remove Hamas from power and to defend themselves against subsequent attacks from Hamas.”** Teichert stated. **“They have taken their time thus far now 10 days after the brutal attack on Israel to try to make sure that what they do militarily will help them achieve their objectives.”**
Teichert’s response came as reports stated that Israel’s ground offensive against Hamas may not take place in one unison invasion, [but rather in phases](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=743334a788&e=1b1fb1ad9f) to weaken Hamas over time. Teichert agreed that a slow progression through invasion of cities in Gaza and cutting supply lines will result in less civilian casualties and removal of Hamas from power.
When asked whether or not he believed the [bombing of Gaza hospital](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=1d539a78d2&e=1b1fb1ad9f) was an attack by Israel, Teichert responded, **“My experience in the region suggests Israel cares far more for the Palestinians than Hamas does, and I suspect if they go back and do the forensics on this one that it’s unlikely that the IDF would be responsible.”**

subject: Less than a Year from the Start of the 2024 Election, RITE Races to Resolve Critical Legal Questions
body:
We’re less than a year from the beginning of voting for the 2024 election. RITE was founded to help restore fading voter confidence in the ballot box by countering activist lawsuits and wayward election administration. In Arizona—where RITE just won a major victory that will push the state to follow the law in confirming the validity of mail ballots—a recent poll found that just 13.4% of GOP voters are very confident in the outcome of elections. In Pennsylvania, another battleground state, only 8% of Republicans say they would be very confident in the results if the election used mail ballots. These are very concerning numbers. ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️

** The Latest from RITE
------------------------------------------------------------
The time to demand lawful election procedures is now, not after an election. That is why RITE is in court in a dozen states, preserving elections as the democratic voice of the people. Read the latest on our cases in New York, Arizona, Ohio, and Maryland.

** In New York, RITE Leads a Coalition Challenging the Unconstitutional Expansion of Absentee Voting
------------------------------------------------------------

RITE is supporting a coalition of voters, election officials, candidates, and political parties in challenging the recent expansion of New York's absentee voting law signed by Governor Kathy Hochul. The Early Mail Voter Act allows no-excuse absentee balloting, which violates the state's constitutional demand that voting take place in person, with only limited exceptions for people away from their homes or physically unable to go to the polling place. In addition to being unconstitutional, the law brazenly ignores the express will of New Yorkers, who voted resoundingly in 2021 to retain strong restrictions on absentee balloting. Preliminary arguments are already underway. Visit the case page. (https://riteusa.org/our-cases/stefanik-v-hochul/)

** RITE Spearheads a Victory for Election Integrity in Arizona
------------------------------------------------------------
An Arizona court ruled for RITE in a challenge to the Arizona Secretary of State’s unlawful signature-match process. The Secretary had instructed county recorders to use a broader and less reliable universe of comparison signatures, which led to ballots being counted despite using a signature that did not match anything in the voter's registration record. The Superior Court for the County of Yavapai agreed with RITE that the state was conducting signature matching in an unlawful manner. The court stated that Arizona's statute is clear and unambiguous and that the Secretary was contradicting the statute's plain language by allowing signature comparison with documents that have nothing to do with the act of registering. Visit the case page. (https://riteusa.org/our-cases/arizona-free-enterprise-club-v-fontes/)

** In Ohio Election Law Challenge, RITE asks Court to Give Elias the Boot
------------------------------------------------------------
On October 6th, RITE filed a motion for summary judgment in Northeast Ohio Coalition v. LaRose because activist lawyers failed to provide any evidence of a single voter who was disadvantaged by Ohio's election integrity reforms. RITE is arguing reforms like photo ID or security measures for drop boxes are essential for administrable, trustworthy elections. Learn more. (https://riteusa.org/our-cases/northeast-ohio-coalition-for-the-homeless-v-larose/)

** Maryland State Board of Elections Faces Litigation Notice for Violating Transparency Laws
------------------------------------------------------------
The Maryland State Board of Elections has been issued a litigation notice by RITE on behalf of two Maryland residents. The notice highlights the Board's violation of the National Voter Registration Act, the First Amendment, and state law. The Board has adopted policies that prevent citizens from accessing the state's voter list if they intend to use the information to identify illegal activity related to the voting process. Maryland has no legal right to shut the public out of its own system of government. Instead of operating in secret, Maryland would be better off running elections its citizens can trust. Maryland has until December to respond to RITE’s inquiry. Learn more. (https://riteusa.org/rite-puts-maryland-on-alert-for-voter-registration-act-violations/)

** RITE supports Kansas in the League of Women Voters v. Schwab case with an amicus brief
------------------------------------------------------------
RITE submitted an amicus brief to the Kansas Supreme Court in support of the state in League of Women Voters v. Schwab. Kansas imposed reasonable safeguards on its absentee voting system, including signature matching and a ten-ballot harvesting limit. Activist plaintiffs challenged these safeguards as violating their right to vote and found success in the Kansas appellate court. RITE's amicus brief clarifies that absentee voting must be regulated for the system to work, and the court of appeals' approach amounts to an unlawful judicial takeover of Kansas's election law. Learn more (https://riteusa.org/in-the-kansas-supreme-court-rite-argues-lower-court-abused-its-role-in-forbidding-the-legislature-from-regulating-mail-in-voting/) .

** ICYMI: Read More from RITE in the Opinion Pages
------------------------------------------------------------
Derek Lyons: Early Mail Voter Act goes against the will of NY voters
The Buffalo News (https://buffalonews.com/opinion/another-voice-inventing-new-voting-laws-crushes-democracy-in-new-york/article_a6f0951c-5c6a-11ee-87b6-f349fb3b3213.html)

...But partisan lawmakers, lawyers, bureaucrats and activists do not let the will of the people stop them from imposing their preferred policies. Instead of respecting New Yorkers’ decision, they enacted the so-called Early Mail Voter Act, which Gov. Kathy Hochul signed into law on Sept. 20. This new legislation grants every New Yorker the right to vote by mail, no excuse required. That’s right. Clever lawyers are telling us that absentee voting (by mail) is somehow different than early voting (by mail). This is nothing more than Orwellian language manipulation. When the Albany ruling class wants to evade the prohibition on no-excuse absentee voting, they reinterpret it to allow voting by mail without excuse. (Read More (https://buffalonews.com/opinion/another-voice-inventing-new-voting-laws-crushes-democracy-in-new-york/article_a6f0951c-5c6a-11ee-87b6-f349fb3b3213.html) )

May Mailman: Michigan’s fraudulent registration scheme is no blessing
The Center Square (https://www.thecentersquare.com/michigan/article_797d6da0-4066-11ee-9d64-1bf85527abae.html)

That’s why Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE) and its affiliated PAC (RITE PAC) are defending state efforts to regulate entities like GBI Strategies throughout the country, including in places like Florida and Kansas. These laws do things like require voters to personally fill out and physically sign their own registration applications. They also require entities to register with the state, preclude felons from collecting registration applications, and limit the number of applications any one person can submit. In every case, these states are trying to ensure more voter involvement and less third-party involvement in the process. That is basic risk management, making it more likely that, when there is fraud, it is individualized, detected, and does not infect the system as a whole. (Read More (https://www.thecentersquare.com/michigan/article_797d6da0-4066-11ee-9d64-1bf85527abae.html) )

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:

| Dear Fellow American,

**Who can you trust in Washington?**
The Biden administration is riddled with corruption, driven by a hard-left agenda, and contemptuous of the rule of law and the American people's "right to know."
The establishment media is just as committed to the Biden agenda as the Biden administration.
And Congress lurches between deadlock and dysfunctionality.
So...who can you trust in Washington?
The answer is clear: Judicial Watch!
As a conservative who closely follows current events, you know how hard Judicial Watch works every day to fight __against__ corruption, __for__ the rule of law, and __for__ the American people's "right to know."
And I am sure you can appreciate that as the one _independent_ , _conservative watchdog_ in Washington the demands on our investigators and lawyers are enormous... _and that in our legal fights every dollar counts_!
**[That’s why I urge you to help us again today with a special donation.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65462&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)**

---

I am asking you to give Judicial Watch your support today because our work has never been important.

Whether it is fighting to keep our elections honest and open only to eligible American citizens...

...or going to court to force the release of documents that "we the people" have a right to see...

...or continuing to expose Biden family corruption that government agencies try to cover up...

...Judicial Watch has dug in for the legal long haul!

[And the generous support we receive from our dedicated members](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65462&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580) is essential to every Freedom of Information Act request and every lawsuit we file!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65462&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

There are times when I fear our Republic is teetering from persistent attacks by the Left, by the Biden administration, and by corrupt politicians in both parties.

But there is no other group better able to counter these forces, educate the public and defend our threatened U.S. Constitution than Judicial Watch, through our full arsenal of independent investigations, lawsuits and other legal actions.

Your support of our work will serve as a real cornerstone which allows us to continue to be the most effective watchdog group in America.

[That's why I hope you will make your best tax-deductible gift today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65462&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580) so we can continue to respond rapidly and effectively as we fight for you and for America.

We need you to chip in whatever you can — $5, $24, $50 — to help our grassroots team stay strong as we get ready for 2024.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71819223/433390008/1242343960?amount=24&refcode=10192023_md_midmonth_fr_3&refcode2=d638b3e7-896e-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjM4YjNlNy04OTZlLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AsyA85nKzoXLMz1yLv1id5RRMtydZiFF1BDwCZ4K6cc=)** **Begin forwarded message:**
> Peter, to be perfectly frank with you, these last few weeks have been some of the most frustrating I’ve experienced since coming to Congress in 2019. **First,** on September 30, we narrowly avoided a Republican-manufactured government shutdown at the eleventh hour.

> **Then,** the deeply-divided Republican majority ousted the Speaker of the House for the first time in American history. The ongoing Speaker election has proved just how committed my colleagues across the aisle are to placating the furthest right in their ranks.

| Dear Supporter,
In less than 48 hours I will be making the biggest announcement of my political career.
We are starting a state-wide campaign to retake the RNC for the grassroots of Colorado. Ensuring representation the way we want it across our state.
When we win in 2024, the establishment swamp will no longer control the RNC and it is my hope that you will join me as we kick off this campaign to Save the Republican Party and Return the RNC to Patriotism.
Our kickoff event will be this Saturday, October 21st at 2:00 PM at the Colorado Automobile Dealers Association and I would appreciate your attendance and support.
By attending, we can show the establishment that the grassroots will not be silenced any longer and that we want a say in how the Republican Party operates.

While social media may be a relatively new platform for the marketplace of ideas, It's the primary public square today when it comes to discussion. Yet government actors have demonstrated that they believe it offers them opportunities to silence viewpoints they don't like. Take this example: Earlier this month, Alliance Defending Freedom filed a friend-of-the-court brief in favor of two parents in southern California who were censored and blocked on social media. **Their crime? _Publicly voicing disagreement with two school board members over matters of government. _** After both parents sued on grounds of free speech violations, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit agreed-the parents' speech had indeed been unlawfully suppressed. In another case involving government suppression of speech, _State of Missouri and State of Louisiana v. Biden_ , ADF filed a brief urging the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 5th Circuit to rule in favor of the State of Missouri and the State of Louisiana-against the Biden administration. In this case, the district court ruled that the Biden administration repeatedly pressured social media companies to censor speech government officials did not like. In the brief, ADF attorneys show how Big Tech's overly vague policies prohibiting "hate speech" and the like set the stage for this kind of censorship. **The administration has even gone so far as to use the FBI to pressure Twitter to target conservative thought leaders. ** Yes, you read that right. In a written statement presented before the House of Representatives in March, journalist Matt Taibbi detailed his shock when what's known as the "Twitter Files" were released last year. Subsequent to Elon Musk's acquiring Twitter (now rebranded as 'X'), the Tesla mogul uncovered the level of censorship that had previously taken place behind Twitter's doors. "We learned Twitter, Facebook, Google, and other companies developed a formal system for taking in moderation "requests" from every corner of government," said Taibbi. "The FBI, DHS, HHS, DOD, the Global Engagement Center at State, even the CIA... A focus of this growing network is making lists of people whose opinions, beliefs, associations, or sympathies are deemed 'misinformation'..." **Our public officials, our public _servants_ , have been scheming against the very people who helped put them in office. ** In July, a federal district court ruled against the administration, writing that **"If the allegations by plaintiffs are true, the present case arguably involves the most massive attack against free speech in United States' history." ** The Biden administration has appealed the ruling. Big Tech is being pressured by the government to censor disfavored views. **[This is blatantly illegal.
