name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: Continuing the Chaos in the House
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
As you no doubt know, we have been without a Speaker of the House for two weeks now. At a time of great uncertainty and challenge, the House needs a Speaker. The inability of House Republicans to elect a Speaker bespeaks a much deeper problem—an inability to govern.
This week, House Republicans nominated Jim Jordan, founder of the House Freedom Caucus whose entire tenure in the House has been about impeding rather than advancing responsible governance, as their Speaker nominee. Two hundred House Republicans voted to elect him. Fortunately for the country, more than 20 of them did not.
Many people know of him because of his dangerous, destructive, and divisive approach to his service in the House that has made headlines for years. His obstruction forced harmful government shutdowns in 2013 and again in 2018. One fact that I learned this week speaks to this lack of seriousness (and demonstrates his lack of preparedness for the job): Jordan has not introduced a single bill that has become law in his 16 years in Congress.
Jordan has not only failed to demonstrate any interest in governing, he has demonstrated hostility to the House of Representatives and to its fundamental purpose. He was one of the leaders of Trump’s effort to overturn the 2020 election. And the same election denial and strongarm tactics we saw then are appearing in the Speaker elections now. At least one member of Congress has even reported receiving death threats for voting against him this week. We cannot govern this way. And we don’t have to.
House Democrats have conveyed our commitment to finding a bipartisan path forward to our colleagues on the other side of the aisle. We understand that we are not in the House majority and that we cannot expect to have a Democratic Speaker of the House right now—that is, until we take back the House after the 2024 elections. But House Republicans have a choice: they can vote to hand the Speaker’s gavel to Jim Jordan and the extremists that have dominated the House, or they can work with Democrats to govern responsibly and deliver for the American people.
In Congress, we will continue to reach across the aisle to find common ground when possible and to stand up to extremism when necessary.
In our community, our team will continue to do everything we can to win our race, help win back the House, and put our country back on a path to progress.
We did it in 2018, and we absolutely must do it again in 2024. Thanks for all you have done and will do to make that happen.
Together, we can do anything,
Lizzie_signature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

body:
Our politicians have let a dangerous drug cartel get away with letting Americans die.
#
Peter — our politicians have let a dangerous drug cartel get away with letting Americans die. **That cartel is called Big Pharma.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38628?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp)
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[chip in anything you can toward my grassroots campaign to defeat Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38628?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp) But first, will you give me a moment to explain?**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38628?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp)**
In America, just three wholesalers control 90% of drug distribution for pharmacies.
A handful of giant overseas companies control 80% of our drug supply chain.
And now, for longer than a year, drug shortages have been up by 30%.
**People will die, but Big Pharma will STILL manage to pull in record profits.** That’s what monopoly power looks like.
Meanwhile, the facts are clear: We CAN make these essential drugs in America and get them to those who need them — but Big Pharma chooses not to.
**To their top executives, record-breaking profits matter more than the drug shortages that cost Americans their lives and livelihoods.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38628?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp)
And why haven’t our politicians done anything big about this? **Money.**
That’s why I don’t take a cent from Big Pharma executives in this Senate campaign — and it’s why I’m fighting to ban stocks for members of Congress, including fake “blind” trusts.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38628?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp)
**When we cut through the corporate corruption that’s gripping Washington, there is so much we can achieve for Missouri and our entire country** — creating jobs, getting people the medications they need at a price they can afford, and building up the American workers and businesses that make our nation strong.
**But it won’t be possible without your help, Peter.[So please, will you help me take this fight to the U.S. Senate by adding a donation of $10 or any amount you think is best toward my campaign today? I don’t take a single cent from corporate PACs so that when I’m elected, I’ll always work for real people like you.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38628?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp)**

[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38629?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=7&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38629?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=8&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38629?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=9&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38629?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=10&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38629?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=11&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38629?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=12&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38628?refcode=em20231019-4016&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=4016%2E614464%2EExHCnp)

And I can promise you this: **I’ll fight like hell against any corrupt politician who gets in my way — in OUR way.**

Lucas Kunce

name: Eric H. Holder, Jr.
subject: Complacency is not an option.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President
body:
|
---

North Carolina is a highly competitive and evenly politically-divided state with an equal number of Democrats and Republicans now representing its citizens in Congress. This fair split is based on fair maps drawn within the very recent past. Yet, these newest lines drawn by a highly partisan state legislature are created to diminish the voting power of the state’s most populous, diverse communities and erase competition between both parties for the rest of the decade.

The new maps are based on political fear and arrogance. They are neither reflective of, nor will they be responsive to, the voters of North Carolina.

It should not be lost on the public that the Republicans who support these egregious gerrymanders are the same politicians who attempted—and failed—to use the U.S. Supreme Court to weaken our system of checks and balances for the sake of gerrymandering. They have been emboldened by a state supreme court that operated on political opportunism and ideological bias in reversing, without a sound legal basis, a very recent precedent from the very same court.

**But make no mistake, the fair maps movement will continue in North Carolina. We have a long road ahead of us that will be filled with more victories than losses, but this fight requires everyone to continuously stay engaged at every level to protect our hard won and precious democracy._Complacency is not an option._**

Eric H. Holder, Jr.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

I always start the day by expressing gratitude. Today, I am grateful for all your birthday wishes this past weekend. I am also grateful for the opportunity to serve the great state of Maryland. Serving as your governor is not something I take lightly. This position requires a great amount of honesty, hard work, and transparency. It requires meeting folks where they are and fighting every day to leave no one behind. The work that we are doing in Maryland is bound to make history — and I am proud to lead the charge to make Maryland a national leader. From advancing industries of the future and expanding access to job training programs to celebrating our cultures and communities, we are building a state that is more competitive and more equitable. If you’re with me in this fight, I am humbly asking for your support today. Your contribution today shows that you’re fighting alongside myself, and my team, for a better state and better country. | | Patriot,

---
This week, you saw the sitting president GAG and CENSOR his leading opponent (by a lot!) – _me_ – in yet another blatant attempt to interfere in the 2024 election.
---
But what do the special interest “Republicans” (RINOs as we like to call them) do in the face of this tyranny?

---
These cowards bent the knee, and worse still...

---
**_...They tried to use it to pursue their own political ambitions!_**

---
That’s right, in the face of the most power-drunk and corrupt administration our country has ever known, these RINOs are trying to destroy _OUR_ America First movement instead of going after Joe Biden.

---
**In fact, they’ve even formed an**** _implicit alliance_****with Crooked Joe!**
---
Biden is parroting the _same exact lines_ in his attack ads against us as the RINOs’ very own Deep State-approved, puppet candidate.

But now that I'm well into my first term in Congress, I think it's important you understand my (less than conventional) road here, my experience, and what kind of leader I plan to be. [If you’re short on time, I understand, but please consider chipping in to get us closer to our $10,000 goal and keep me fighting for the most vulnerable among us in Congress >>](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/gu7JjWJseElLYGeBR2lQEQ~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRnE9vTP0TNaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDIzMTAxOV9lbV9mcl9iMV9kZWZ5b2Rkc19lbi1ycyZhbW91bnQ9MjcmY2RtYz0yV3pKTGdRVnF4dXpuN2p4a3UwNEJReEp0YkMmcmVmY29kZTI9Mld6SkxnUVZxeHV6bjdqeGt1MDRCUXhKdGJDJnJlZmNvZGVjZG1jPTJXekpMZ1FWcXh1em43anhrdTA0QlF4SnRiQ1cDc3BjQgplINNWMWU2ZpuwUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAaQ~~) A victim of the system and enmeshed in trying circumstances, my biological mother turned to drugs and crime while she was pregnant with me. She didn’t have healthcare during this time and wasn’t able to see a doctor even once. As the mother of seven, she made the difficult decision to put me up for adoption because she lacked the resources to care and raise another child. I learned all of this just two months before I announced my run for Congress. **Understanding my biological mother’s story and the circumstances surrounding my birth underscored for me why politics is so important. And it further crystallized my core vision of it - that we need our elected leaders who view the world through the eyes of the most vulnerable.** My community needs a leader like that in Congress and I’m running to be that person - someone that fights every day for and with the marginalized and disadvantaged. A champion for working people. This isn’t new for me though. I’ve been fighting for my community since I was 15 years old when I became an advocate for ending gun violence following the Sandy Hook shooting. After the death of George Floyd, I became one of the lead Black Lives Matters organizers in Orlando, where I went out every day to fight for justice and Black lives. I was beaten by cops, tear-gassed, and jailed for those efforts. In 2018, I helped lead the ACLU of Florida’s fight to win Amendment 4, which restored voting rights to over 1.6 million Floridians who had previous felony convictions. While at the ACLU in 2020, I worked to win Biden’s support for abolishing the Hyde Amendment, legislation that has limited abortion access for millions of people. As Organizing Director at March for Our Lives, one of the largest youth political movements in the country, I led an ambitious voter turnout program that helped drive a record number of young people to the polls, helping to hold the House, and win a Democratic Senate, and Presidency. **I share all of this with you, so you understand the kind of leader I am and will continue to be.** [Peter, I didn’t make it this far on my own and I’m going to need _your support_ to continue my fight in Congress. | Peter, I have incredible news in my race to defeat Sen. Rick Scott here in Florida — and I wanted you to hear it from me:

_**A new poll already shows this race in a statistical tie!**_

I’ve always believed that we can reach our dreams if we _work_ for them. That’s what’s so great about this country. I came to this country at 14 and worked for minimum wage at a doughnut shop, so I know the value of hard work. I know that with hard work, determination, and the grassroots support of people like you — we’ll elect someone who’s proof of the American dream as Florida’s next U.S. senator.

But I need to be frank about what’s ahead of us: Rick Scott has already sunk _millions_ of dollars of his own money into his campaign. I simply will not be able to compete without grassroots resources.**That's why my team and I have set a weekly $50,000 goal to ensure we can fight Scott’s wealth, build our campaign, and win.**

With grassroots support of the utmost importance, I checked your donation record to see where things stand. Could you please chip in? **Supporter: dpwillis67@gmail.com

# Matthew Bartlett
# Co-Founder of Darby Field Advisors
---
---
|
---
In this episode of Navigating Uncertainty, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Matthew Bartlett, co-Founder of Darby Field Advisors. Matt shares his story of growing up in Nashua, learning about politics, and becoming a liberal activist before working in the Trump Administration. He also describes his work with U2's Bono (and the State Department) on public health which has (to date) saved more than 25 million lives. Matt's advice for navigating uncertainty: "Dreams should not be lost on pillows" so seize the opportunities you have!
Please tune in via any of the links below, or if you'd prefer to watch the conversation, please visit mansharamani.substack.com for link to the video.
---
PRIOR EPISODES ALL AVAILABLE ON DEMAND!
For those who missed the prior episodes of NAVIGATING UNCERTAINTY, have no fear! They're all available on demand via the links below. As you sit in traffic during your weekend trips, tune in and use the opportunity to learn about some fascinating people as well as some of the most important topics of our times!
You'll find my conversations with Mary Steady, Director of Pupil Services at LinWood Public Schools, Mike Dennehy, Public and Political Affairs Consultant, Lori Van Dusen, Founder of LVW Advisors, Fahim Fazli, Actor and Hollywood Insider, Robert Reynolds, CEO of Putnam Investments, Dr. Benjamin Kilham, founder of the Kilham Bear Center, Ashlee Vance, Author of When the Heavens Went on Sale, Darrell Hartman, Author of The Battle of Ink & Ice, Jim Cantrell, Co-Founder of SpaceX and Founder of Phantom Space, Dean Carucci, CEO of the Portsmouth Regional Hospital, GOP Presidential Candidate Doug Burgum, Jack Heath, Host of Good Morning New Hampshire, John Formella, Attorney General of New Hampshire, Dean Kamen, Founder of DEKA Research, Donald Kreis, Consumer Advocate for the State of NH, Jeremy Hitchcock, Founder of Dyn and Executive Chairman of Minim, Phil Taub, Partner at NixonPeabody and Co-Founder of SWIM WITH A MISSION, Morgan Ortagus, Former Spokesperson for the State Department, David Jordan, Founder of Seven Hills Foundation, John Avlon, Senior Political Analyst at CNN, Derek Leathers, Chairman & CEO of Werner Enterprises, Rudy Glocker, Founder of Burgeon Outdoor, former US Senator Kelly Ayotte, NCUA Vice Chair Kyle Hauptman, Miami Mayor Francis Suarez, NH Governor Chris Sununu, NH Education Czar Frank Edelblut, Commissioner of Business and Economic Affairs Taylor Caswell, GOP Presidential Candidate Vivek Ramaswamy, former Commander of NORAD and Retired Four Star General Lori Robinson, and former Chair of House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence Mike Rogers.

Navigating Uncertainty is a show in which acclaimed global trend-watcher and futurist [Vikram Mansharamani](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qt-moQP9swAzt6UmTrJ52oBXDtPYaUJfrpfHzIuX5r-2MS5WXlUVIwMjVvO2H1J67YNAl789XN1ClkpXvVAyn7bIc7XSGS5VQAUPcmBd7hMJpzUgvbieFJStaFXKi0TOr2CjBy-tc89DCQ9Xf2LFuw==&c=Hpg3dC6cInKEanqPx3H-uss369muLOhU_nnBhRlALmndQKJxEG9q1w==&ch=lvqLrpTCfvWStkL8Uj6Z1Qt4Y3Ml21DUgivHD_a-f_8n4PDFqVv9lw==) dives into how leaders make decisions. Through long-form conversations that move beyond sound-bites, Dr. Mansharamani explores how some of the most successful people think about tough choices. Serious, irreverent, entertaining, heart-warming, and occasionally tear-jerking, Navigating Uncertainty offers listeners bite-sized authentic biographies of high-impact leaders from all walks of life.Weekly episodes are released every Thursday via Apple Podcast, Spotify and everywhere podcasts are generally available!

To stay in touch with Dr. Mansharaman and to subscribe (for free) to his weekly newsletter, please visit [mansharamani.substack.com](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qt-moQP9swAzt6UmTrJ52oBXDtPYaUJfrpfHzIuX5r-2MS5WXlUVI86L_2sKX9QQKlZEdnTYuEezDI3qZfemeI_xL4YmCdSWUVENqc0RkCwlVfip_vFeOUylho_VEC2ybzAoD0y_IYplaU9KcEbcGpCjuvOe41c5&c=Hpg3dC6cInKEanqPx3H-uss369muLOhU_nnBhRlALmndQKJxEG9q1w==&ch=lvqLrpTCfvWStkL8Uj6Z1Qt4Y3Ml21DUgivHD_a-f_8n4PDFqVv9lw==)

I’m proud of my mom, so it’s fun to see what different people appreciate about her.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=31712%2E3422442%2Ev2dxYT)
Hey there, it’s Paul, Katie Porter’s son!
Since my mom was elected to Congress, trips to normal places take longer than usual. People stop her in grocery stores and airports, everywhere really. **I’m proud of my mom, so it’s fun to see what different people appreciate about her.**
Some people like her for silly things like our minivan or her whiteboard. **But most people who come up to my mom talk to her about Congressional Hearings where she absolutely wrecks corporate CEOs,** or when she breaks down complex legislative ideas so average Joes like you and me can understand them. Sometimes people come up to her and tell her their problems. But no matter what the issue is, she's always able to give them an idea for how they might be able to solve it.

_Here’s my siblings and me in the campaign office when my mom first ran for Congress in 2018._
Right now, my mom is extra busy, because in addition to being a Congresswoman and mom, she’s running to be the next U.S. Senator from California. But she always says this is a team effort. For me and my siblings that means helping out with dishes and laundry while she’s away, and my brother and I have become pro door knockers thanks to each of my mom’s past campaigns. Peter,
**Yesterday, Republicans failed yet again to elect a Speaker of the House of Representatives.** Donald Trump’s pick, Jim Jordan, earned even fewer votes on the second ballot than on the first.

Conditioned by Fox News (and later Donald Trump) to support elected officials with a burn-it-down mentality, Fox News audiences carried so many MAGA candidates to victory that they now make up a massive portion of the House Republican caucus.
**After failing to elect a House Speaker, they’ve succeeded in grinding democracy to a halt for 16 days and counting.**

name: Tom Barrett for Congress
subject: Illegal immigration at Southern Border reaches 24-year high
body:
Border Patrol reported 219,000 border enforcements in September alone | | | [](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=653170c92f051c2522ce6374&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftombarrettforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D65315ee40def701d3ef25aef%26ss_email_id%3D653170c92f051c2522ce6374%26ss_campaign_name%3DIllegal%2Bimmigration%2Bat%2BSouthern%2BBorder%2Breaches%2B24-year%2Bhigh%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2023-10-19T18%253A10%253A00Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65315ee40def701d3ef25aef&l=en-US&s=BCUqG9curaoMQYfzDU3qWvOFhqk%3D)
---
| Today, the [Daily Caller published a story](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=653170c92f051c2522ce6374&u=https%3A%2F%2Fdailycaller.com%2F2023%2F10%2F19%2Fillegal-immigration-southern-border-surges-new-september-record%2F%3Fpnespid%3Dsrd1VX1GK.gG26jJoCSlFpGCvw.2BYZnJve.wbJpqgdmaLsH7lC_axroAlr8T9x3M_hNsEkDYg&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65315ee40def701d3ef25aef&l=en-US&s=FcThuVbi-XSFtFrLIPIcAwpsi7E%3D) showing just how out-of-control our southern border is. Based on internal documents from the U.S. Customs and Border Protection, the agency reported 218,777 encounters at the border in September alone, with more than 2 million for the fiscal year.
---
|
---
[_ _ Fix the Border!_ _](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=653170c92f051c2522ce6374&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ffixtheborder&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65315ee40def701d3ef25aef&l=en-US&s=SOhhsain2Vybgl0d83dQB_69vZw%3D)
---
---
|
---
We have to stop the insanity at our border and that’s why I’m running for Congress.I served 22-years in the U.S. Army, including the Iraq War. I’ve given more than half my life to keeping Americans safe. In Congress, I will continue to keep us safe by sealing our border and keeping drugs, criminals, and terrorists out of our country. **It should be our #1 job!** If I am elected to Congress, you can count on me to:
* Finish the Wall
* Hire more border patrol agents
* Fine any business who hires illegal laborers
* Increase the penalties for the importation of fentanyl

---
[_ _ I want to help!_ _](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=653170c92f051c2522ce6374&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ffixtheborder&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65315ee40def701d3ef25aef&l=en-US&s=SOhhsain2Vybgl0d83dQB_69vZw%3D)
---
[**Help me get to Washington to fix the mess with an online donation today. Any amount, $10, $25, $50 or $100 will help us reach our goal.**](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=653170c92f051c2522ce6374&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ffixtheborder&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65315ee40def701d3ef25aef&l=en-US&s=SOhhsain2Vybgl0d83dQB_69vZw%3D) I know times are tough but we have to do something.[**If you can afford more, please consider $250 or even $500.**](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=653170c92f051c2522ce6374&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ffixtheborder&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65315ee40def701d3ef25aef&l=en-US&s=SOhhsain2Vybgl0d83dQB_69vZw%3D)
---
|
---
**About Tom Barrett**
---
| [](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=653170c92f051c2522ce6374&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DruD_qQ61TfE&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_65315ee40def701d3ef25aef&l=en-US&s=bSjNyyxTnQK0TrTu-X6_N6myNs0%3D)
---
Tom Barrett was born and raised here in Michigan. He learned the value of hard work and the importance of family by watching his dad work two jobs while his mom stayed home to raise him and his six siblings. As Tom was finishing high school, he decided to join the United States Army and serve his country. After graduation he took the first airplane ride of his life as he departed for Basic Combat Training at Fort Sill, Oklahoma.Tom’s service in the military continued for 22 years, serving in the Iraq War, Guantanamo Bay, Kuwait, and the Korean DMZ, and logging in more than 1,000 hours in some of the most advanced helicopters in the world.When Tom returned to Michigan, he was shocked to find so many veterans struggling to find opportunities back home. Michigan had the second highest veteran unemployment rate in the nation and Tom decided to act, running for the legislature and becoming a leading voice for veterans in Lansing.Known as a fiscal hawk, he opposed all taxpayer-funded corporate welfare, including the programs now funding Chinese-owned factories, and fought for tax cuts for all Michiganders.Tom attended Western Michigan University on the Montgomery GI Bill and graduated with honors in 2007. He lives in Charlotte with his wife, Ashley, and their four young children, Patrick, Eleanora, Gwendolyn, and Louis. He is running for Congress to restore our commitment to America, and the values that took us from a fragile new republic to become the greatest nation on earth.Michigan’s 7th Congressional District includes all of Ingham, Clinton, Shiawassee, and Livingston Counties, most of Eaton County, and portions of Oakland and Genesee Counties.

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

clean_body: | Hi Peter, I have two Nashville fundraisers coming up, and I’d love to see you at one or both of them! Join me at AB in Hillsboro Village this coming Tuesday for an evening dedicated to celebrating Nashville’s incredible music industry. = = I also hope you will join me on November 9th! Kathy and Bob Olsen have been generous enough to open their home for a fundraiser supporting my campaign, and =** = I have been blown away by the outpouring of support I’ve received since launching this campaign. One of the most important ways you can show your support early on in this race is by investing in our efforts. = | = As I continue traveling the state, I am continually inspired by the Tennesseans I meet on the campaign trail. We are creating a people powered movement for change in our state, and I hope you will stand with us by supporting my campaign. I look forward to seeing you soon in Nashville! Rep. Gloria Johnson | Gloria Johnson is running for the U.S. Senate because Tennesseans deserve leaders who care. For too long, elected officials like Marsha Blackburn have done absolutely nothing to make Tennesseans’ lives better. The only interests they’ve cared about are special interests. name: Team Cornel West 2024
subject: Volunteers! We hear you.
body:
Join our movement for truth, justice and love.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231018all_volteaser&n=1)
---
Dear Peter, We hope this letter finds you in good health and clear spirits. Such historic times call on each of us to rise up and organize. With your help, we can end the hegemony of the two ruling parties. Dr. West’s campaign for the presidency has been through transition and refinement, to build a strong team that will help mobilize the movement we will create together. A movement that centers the precious poor and working class people who are oppressed by our system. As we’ve rebuilt this campaign for success, we know you’ve been waiting to hear from us. THANK YOU for your patience! Now is the time to begin the work of overcoming the duopoly’s iron grip. It’s no secret that onerous ballot access rules are one of the biggest barriers created by Republicans and Democrats to preserve their dominance. Simply put: The fight for ballot access is the fight for democracy. **So we are writing to let you know about the upcoming Volunteer Launch and Ballot Access meeting (invite hitting your inbox by next week).[](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231018all_volteaser&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/volunteer?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231018all_volteaser&n=3 "SIGN-UP TO VOLUNTEER") [SIGN-UP TO VOLUNTEER](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/volunteer?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231018all_volteaser&n=3)
---
Dr. West recently announced that he will run for president as an Independent. There’s been lots of misinformation about what that means. The fact is that in a number of states, ballot access is easier for an Independent candidate than a third party. **Regular ballot access meetings will commence very shortly and we will send you more details as soon as they are available.[In the meantime, if you haven’t filled out a volunteer survey- please do so here.](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/volunteer?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231018all_volteaser&n=4) This will help us understand how you would like to contribute to the campaign and what skills you bring to the table.** Thank you for your continued support of Cornel West's campaign. We look forward to working with you!
---
Solidarity, **Team Cornel West 2024**

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: I lost
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=4254%2E5257348%2EWeFeSW ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Hi Derek, can
I share a picture with you?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231019_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=4254%2E5257348%2EWeFeSW ]Adam Schiff at his Bar Mitzvah

This is me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah.

It’s easy to chuckle at this photo — and see just how far fashion has
changed since that classic absolutely righteous 1970s bowtie — but it is
also an opportunity to tell you about my upbringing.

My family moved around while I was in school before settling in Danville,
California. My parents and my teachers cultivated in me a love of and
respect for public service.

While in speech class, I remember listening to recordings of great
speakers like President John F. Kennedy, the Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King,
Jr., and Winston Churchill. I admired the way they used language — how
they could inspire millions of people to take action through the power of
their words.

I wanted to use words — and actions — in the service of progressive
change. And I wanted to be part of the great struggle for the future.

After graduating high school (I was not valedictorian as some have claimed
— my B in Band held me back), I went on to college and law school. There,
I learned how to gather the facts and argue my case.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231019_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=4254%2E5257348%2EWeFeSW ]Adam Schiff at his graduation

After law school, I was inspired by friends serving in office and decided
I was ready to try. I ran for the California Assembly.

And,
Derek, I
lost.

It was bruising to lose, but I didn’t give up. And then, I lost again. But
I refused to give up hope.

I continued campaigning and rallying — and just two years later, I was
elected to represent the 21st District in the State Senate. I was sworn in
as the California Senate’s youngest member at just 36 years old.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231019_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=4254%2E5257348%2EWeFeSW ]Adam Schiff and Eve Schiff with a yard sign

After the term finished, I threw my hat in the ring to take on the
Republican incumbent in California’s 27th Congressional District. This was
seen as one of the seats that could decide the House majority. Money
poured into this election — the most expensive in history at the time. I
barnstormed the district — speaking with voters to share our message.

Those long months of hard work paid off: Despite the election of George W.
Bush as president and Republicans maintaining their House majority, we
flipped that seat and won that race, and I became only the second Democrat
to represent the district in history.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231019_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=4254%2E5257348%2EWeFeSW ]Adam Schiff and family celebrating

I’ve taken a lot of tough fights in my time,
Derek — and
it’s all been in the name of giving back. We have a saying as part of my
Jewish faith — “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world.

There’s a lot that’s been broken, and a lot to fix. I’m ready to do my
part to leave our state and country in a better place, and to repair our
broken democracy, but I can’t do it alone.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1230?c0=oct2023_abs_em.TYf9-c&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20231019_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=4254%2E5257348%2EWeFeSW ]With less than 150 days until Californians go to the polls, my team
needs your help to share our message across California’s 58 counties and
win this U.S. Senate race. Will you pitch in $5 to help us in these final
few months?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

| | Hi Peter,
Ballots for the 2023 local elections **are already being** **mailed out **so make sure you are checking your mailboxes and have a plan to vote, and vote early! We just activated a new team of seven** trained and verified conservative volunteers **in Pierce County who are building relationships in their neighborhoods. We are helping conservatives get their ballots in right away!

Over the next week we will send you information on how to **track your ballot** to verify that it has been counted. Please check your County GOP website for **voting recommendations** in your area.

I also wanted to send you an update on our '**Secure Your Vote'** program that we launched at the beginning of this month. Chairman Jim Walsh set a goal to reach **200 conservative ballot box centers** before next year's statewide elections.

Thanks to support of grassroots conservatives across the state, our initial launch has **already raised $5,900** to purchase **40 more ballot boxes**. $10, $25, $50, and even the full $150 at a time - **grassroots conservatives** are making an incredible impact in our state. **You can add to the success of this program** by clicking on the blue button below and contributing today. Date: Oct. 10, 2023
Time: 8:45 AM
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Dear Peter,

For decades, Republicans have been asking to vote in-person again in Washington State. **Now you can.**

Republicans have also been worried about whether or not returning a ballot through the Post Office is trustworthy. **Now you don't have to worry about it.**

Over the last month, the Washington State Republican Party has launched a program called**'Secure Your Vote'. **

This program includes several steps that encourages Republicans to vote, promotes legal ballot harvesting, and **helps ensure that every vote is properly counted** at the county elections office.

We are aligned with local businesses, churches, fishing & wildlife shops and conservative leaning groups to organize **conservative ballot box centers **across the state. We are also establishing **grassroots conservative teams** who will help you verify that your ballot was returned and counted by the county elections.

Building the statewide infrastructure for**'Secure Your Vote'** is going to take a lot of grassroots power and resources.**The secure ballot boxes alone can cost up to $150 each - these aren't just a shoe box with a whole cut in it.** And they are accompanied with voter information & materials, ballot tracking, and trained grassroots volunteer teams.

Our first step is to train the grassroots conservative teams and to establish the secure ballot boxes. While we start with training, can you help us put in place more secure ballot boxes?

**With your support, we can hit our goal of 200 verified conservative ballot box centers before the 2024 statewide election.** That's $30,000 just for the secure ballot boxes alone, which we've already spent $4,000 of.

[_**Can you help us reach the last $26,000 with a grassroots contribution of $10, $25, or $50 today?**_](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=0d285fa6ab&e=6a281f566d)

\- 9 conservative ballot boxes in Pierce county with 8 more on the way.

\- 3 In-person voting events organized in Central WA with 8 ballot boxes being deployed this week.

\- 15 churches have established conservative ballot box centers with hundreds of pastors encouraging voting within their congregations.

\- tens-of-thousands of phone calls and text messages are being launched to conservative voters for the 2023 local elections to connect them with our trained and verified grassroots volunteers.

Not every county and district has a fully operational ballot box center yet, or a team of trained and verified grassroots conservatives helping voters secure their vote. We will keep growing. And continue building. **And with your support, by next year we can hit our goal of 200 verified conservative ballot box centers in Washington State.**
---

Republicans in Washington State must start the effort now if we want to win close races for the foreseeable future. We will do it as aggressively as possible. We will conduct our efforts legally and with integrity. And in doing so, **we will start winning again!**

Please support our efforts today to bring this important change to the way our Party operates campaigns. Thank you!

Fellow American,

**Our borders need to be secured.** I visited **_both_** our northern and southern borders recently to learn and get a first-hand account of the state of our borders.

In reality, the fentanyl crisis isn't just happening at our southern border. At just the northern border last year, agents seized _**enough fentanyl to kill more than 3 million Americans.**_ On my visit there – I found a crossroad with two signs. One said, "Prepare to Stop" and the other led on to a "Hiking Trail."

Just a few steps away and crossing an ankle-deep creek, it's simple enough to walk into the United States. **_It was that easy..._**

| [** WATCH MY VIDEO FROM THE SOUTHERN BORDER **](http://links.vivek2024.com/u/click?_t=07471d1165224e98aee1aca8cd71f6e2&_m=09022208b0984b0db0d439cdd68342ab&_e=Rzf7eo1ktKYuDEvONKeuKwlWJ53UPmdRdP5ZBww8U6kTvVjBTcDTN0jiFGa-yiDulANk4-rHWw2owCNakmGiGEt-sq01A_3nSVWEx5i0Rn3nphdpo1StnX9ZNMGZ7rveVTeir1R49omSwPPMngefHBCBfGYONSo1KpHGo7w8Gkw4Fo4plsOr8KArFTEzHHDLJKDC55l0WNUiCgJSLwMk61g0vdF6MLmgZmMubZv8OQiI3_e-DyXYM8jfqxM1Fe7meJCwUEl7T84erSPso9r3xDsmhRyRmIKwGF7SiXtuNe-bnEGf0huJzodERPSy8GUIni4u8vzTUdJ_UzZi2P6CxU4DXrerAHvOfLxU7AB64Mx8il91ZAIJLFdaJ_j6vDdXIpwLmu6PQ3tZDL0OapOw3w%3D%3D)
---

I believe the border crisis is a unifying American issue - one that takes real leadership to answer. Seeing the weaknesses and unreasonable pressure put on our border patrol first-hand, we can start to address the border issues by:
* People whose first act to enter the country illegally **do not belong here.**
* We need to eliminate our lottery-based immigration system and **enact one based on merit.**
* Finally, if we can use our military to secure somebody else's border somewhere else, we can certainly **use our military to secure our southern border** once and for all.

We cannot be complacent about defending our borders. Texas and other border states are doing everything they can to ensure their sovereignty but they need help and leadership from the federal level. [**Fellow American, my visit to our borders was eye opening and I promise you, once elected, we will fix this together.**](http://links.vivek2024.com/u/click?_t=07471d1165224e98aee1aca8cd71f6e2&_m=09022208b0984b0db0d439cdd68342ab&_e=Rzf7eo1ktKYuDEvONKeuKwlWJ53UPmdRdP5ZBww8U6kTvVjBTcDTN0jiFGa-yiDulANk4-rHWw2owCNakmGiGEt-sq01A_3nSVWEx5i0Rn3nphdpo1StnX9ZNMGZ7rveVTeir1R49omSwPPMngefHBCBfGYONSo1KpHGo7w8Gkw4Fo4plsOr8KArFTEzHHDLJKDC55l0WNUiCgJSLwMk61g0vdF6MLmgZmMubZv8OQiI3_e-DyXYM8jfqxM1Fe7mUPMyVpcBFNbNJjH3SypiK47GACEaGkvkTdnX-eMMpx-i2gWKYLu3ng7cM7Vz_yY_ZDS8vhuVwe7KODaSvpv9ibdh7TC7mMwJhTc1FhdCngAipUGSPzBxMuTJvrrGLfdg8mvAU34CoQ7PJr8byZdr9Q%3D%3D)

Thank you,

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

subject: We STILL have no speaker

body:
We’re focusing on the wrong things.
This is sad to watch, team.
We still have no speaker of the House, and the GOP is focused on the wrong priorities. While they focus on political games, there is a hearing in my committee to ban books – _all while Republicans continue bickering amongst themselves. _
Team, we can’t wait while precious time is wasted infighting. I’m ready to get back to work. We are facing a government shutdown in 30 days and are no closer to a resolution.
This has been painful for me to watch, friend. Critical legislation on the line, and I don’t want to spend my time with distractions that do nothing to support the American people.

name: Dr. Brian Williams
subject: We are not powerless to create life-saving change
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Brian Williams for Congress
body:
When my family moved to Dallas, we fell in love with this vibrant community and its traditions. One of our favorite traditions is our yearly trip to the Texas State Fair. | | Peter —

When my family moved to Dallas, we fell in love with this vibrant community and its traditions. One of our favorite traditions is our yearly trip to the Texas State Fair.

Today, I'm thinking about everyone injured or forced to flee last Saturday. Even when lives are not lost, gun violence traumatizes our communities and poisons time we should spend in celebration with our friends and families.

The epidemic of gun violence has touched everyone in this country. No place — whether it be a school, a supermarket, or a state fair — is safe. We do not have to accept this.

**I’ve seen too many preventable deaths and too much suffering due to firearms.** For me, working to end the epidemic of gun violence is more than an academic pursuit or my vocation. It’s personal.

I’ve lost family members to gun violence and as a trauma surgeon, I routinely cared for gunshot victims of all ages, races, and walks of life — and I’ve had to deliver devastating news to far too many families. It’s what inspired me to run for Congress and fight for change.

We’re not powerless to create life-saving change, Peter. But passing meaningful gun safety reform and allowing our communities to heal from the collective trauma of gun violence can not happen without your help. **[Will you sign this petition to stand with me in the fight against gun violence?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71854974/433477110/1504278842?ms=em23_231019_TSF_adv_gq_act___DBW_ettx&refcode=em23_231019_TSF_adv_gq_act___DBW_ettx&source=em23_231019_TSF_adv_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_231019_TSF_adv_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=nbRAZkOlNgDjcMWqOossvLXnhbK4bzPKRgSou1F4uERCg74yQvmIwgCVF2AttCh1RpOmlWh711M3ZEemh//6GpecUk43lNZJ46D7D70eMDwqY7t62wTBgyv3/WgFllkoS29PG+aDJKthYbTqpe1Qcw==&refcode2=e4f32cba-b76e-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTRmMzJjYmEtYjc2ZS1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=epo5mR1HgFk5Eyap9wAoViUiwpyXqUEajvR3NL3SnQ4=&emci=e5ba616d-8f6e-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=e4f32cba-b76e-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=13153572)**

clean_body: When my family moved to Dallas, we fell in love with this vibrant community and its traditions. One of our favorite traditions is our yearly trip to the Texas State Fair. | | Peter — When my family moved to Dallas, we fell in love with this vibrant community and its traditions. One of our favorite traditions is our yearly trip to the Texas State Fair. Today, I'm thinking about everyone injured or forced to flee last Saturday. Even when lives are not lost, gun violence traumatizes our communities and poisons time we should spend in celebration with our friends and families. The epidemic of gun violence has touched everyone in this country. No place — whether it be a school, a supermarket, or a state fair — is safe. We do not have to accept this. I’ve seen too many preventable deaths and too much suffering due to firearms. For me, working to end the epidemic of gun violence is more than an academic pursuit or my vocation. It’s personal. I’ve lost family members to gun violence and as a trauma surgeon, I routinely cared for gunshot victims of all ages, races, and walks of life — and I’ve had to deliver devastating news to far too many families. It’s what inspired me to run for Congress and fight for change. We’re not powerless to create life-saving change, Peter. But passing meaningful gun safety reform and allowing our communities to heal from the collective trauma of gun violence can not happen without your help. Onward, Dr. Brian Williams | | Click to unsubscribe from our email list. subject: Here’s the real cost of “unwinding” Medicaid in Georgia.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Georgia Blue PAC
body:
Peter,

The radical GOP and Governor Kemp are intent on putting Georgians who receive Medicaid through an arduous and costly requalification process. They’d like you to believe that this will somehow “clean up the system.” But here are the real facts:

1. The unwinding process will cost Georgians MORE than expanding Medicaid.
2. New work requirements disadvantage low-income Georgians.
3. Nearly 550,000 Georgians could lose coverage due to administrative problems.
4. Those suffering most? CHILDREN. Last month, more than 63,000 kids lost their coverage.

The GOP is trying to cover this up with their usual smoke-and-mirrors tricks. But we know better. So we have two actions for you today:

Friend,

It’s time for change... are you ready for it?

subject: Sign The Petition: Manatees vs. Cruise Ships
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2061369?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: The last of Florida’s precious manatees are being pushed closer to EXTINCTION by the greedy Big Cruise industry![Take action now >>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2061370?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Manatees are one of the most beloved creatures of the sea, known for their large size and friendly demeanor. But these serene, gentle giants are being _**threatened by rampant cruise ship pollution**_ in their native Florida waters, _and we’re running out of time to help save them._ While these vulnerable animals are already dying out in RECORD NUMBERS, massive cruise vessels continue to recklessly spew out _**dirty emissions**_ into the atmosphere and dump _**toxic waste**_ into the ocean — _**contributing to irreparable habitat loss and drastic lack of food supply for manatees.**_ In fact, we’ve already **lost 25% of the entire manatee population** in the last two years alone — _nearing 2,000 manatee deaths!_ **Friend, the situation is dire — manatees might soon disappear forever if we don’t take urgent action.** _**Your voice today could help determine the fate of these precious marine animals.**_ **[Will you speak up right now in defense of manatees and help protect them from being WIPED OUT by Big Cruise’s corporate greed?](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2061371?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2061372?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Manatees depend on a plant called seagrass as their main food source — _**without it, they cannot survive.**_ Due to the decimation of seagrass beds in part due to corporate cruise pollution, manatees are rapidly dying of _**STARVATION.**_ Many of them are even _**DROWNING TO DEATH**_ because they aren’t getting enough nutrients to keep them fat enough to remain afloat.
Seagrass isn’t just vital for manatees, but it also plays a key role in protecting our planet by curbing climate change and keeping our ocean ecosystems healthy. The ocean provides at least _**HALF of all the Earth’s oxygen,**_ and seagrass itself stores almost _**1⁄5 of the whole world’s ocean carbon!**_
But despite all of the environmental benefits of this essential plant, profit-driven cruise corporations are more concerned with their bottom line. Dirty, toxic wastewater from cruise ships dump contaminants into manatee habitat, harming water quality and contributing to algal blooms that become so thick they block sunlight and **prevent seagrass growth. **
Unless the Environmental Protection Agency steps up immediately to _**STOP out-of-control cruise ship pollution,**_ there could be _**catastrophic consequences to our oceans, marine life, nearby coastal communities, AND the entire planet.**_ [**But we still need 4,397 more activist signatures by our 11:59 P.M. deadline if we’re going to persuade the EPA to hold Big Cruise accountable. Can we count on you to add your name while there’s still time, Friend?**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2061373?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

clean_body: | | | | | == ---|---|--- | | URGENT ACTION NEEDED: The last of Florida’s precious manatees are being pushed closer to EXTINCTION by the greedy Big Cruise industry Manatees are one of the most beloved creatures of the sea, known for their large size and friendly demeanor. But these serene, gentle giants are being threatened by rampant cruise ship pollution in their native Florida waters, and we’re running out of time to help save them. While these vulnerable animals are already dying out in RECORD NUMBERS, massive cruise vessels continue to recklessly spew out dirty emissions into the atmosphere and dump toxic waste into the ocean — contributing to irreparable habitat loss and drastic lack of food supply for manatees. In fact, we’ve already lost 25% of the entire manatee population in the last two years alone — nearing 2,000 manatee deaths! Friend, the situation is dire — manatees might soon disappear forever if we don’t take urgent action. Your voice today could help determine the fate of these precious marine animals. == | == Manatees depend on a plant called seagrass as their main food source — without it, they cannot survive. Due to the decimation of seagrass beds in part due to corporate cruise pollution, manatees are rapidly dying of STARVATION. Many of them are even DROWNING TO DEATH because they aren’t getting enough nutrients to keep them fat enough to remain afloat. Seagrass isn’t just vital for manatees, but it also plays a key role in protecting our planet by curbing climate change and keeping our ocean ecosystems healthy. The ocean provides at least HALF of all the Earth’s oxygen, and seagrass itself stores almost 1⁄5 of the whole world’s ocean carbon! But despite all of the environmental benefits of this essential plant, profit-driven cruise corporations are more concerned with their bottom line. Dirty, toxic wastewater from cruise ships dump contaminants into manatee habitat, harming water quality and contributing to algal blooms that become so thick they block sunlight and prevent seagrass growth. Unless the Environmental Protection Agency steps up immediately to STOP out-of-control cruise ship pollution, there could be catastrophic consequences to our oceans, marine life, nearby coastal communities, AND the entire planet. == == Your voice is critical to protecting manatees and our oceans, Friends of the Earth | Contact Us: Friends of the Earth U.S. Washington, D.C. | Berkeley, CA 1-877-843-8687 foe.org/about-us/contact/

body:
**** My colleagues across the aisle will do whatever they can to hold the House majority in 2024, and make no mistake – Pennsylvania is a critical piece of their plan.

The contrast between this Congress and the last is clear. When House Democrats held the majority, we led by passing policies to help all Americans:
* Updated our infrastructure
* Lowered healthcare costs for seniors
* Made major investments in green energy solutions

The GOP majority, on the other hand?
* The first Speaker of the House to take 15 rounds of voting to be elected
* The first Speaker to be voted out _in American history_ – leaving Congress unable to function
* The latest government funding is slated to run out in just under a month – with the GOP divided and no clear path forward, leaving millions of Americans unsure of the future

The truth is, with my colleagues across the aisle in the majority, we’re dangerously close to total dysfunction. That’s why on the campaign trail we must do all that we can to win handily here in the Fourth District. **[If you want to help us in this important work, would you consider making a donation before the week’s end?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71859113/433492165/1242343960?amount=25&refcode=10192023_md_midmonth_fr_4&refcode2=abfec190-c46e-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYmZlYzE5MC1jNDZlLWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j0l3RSLQMn5oyjNeTPgCmyirNvGGG6dalZVCM0ruKxI=)**

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=742%2E135344%2Eyynh-Y)

Friends --
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and his longest serving cabinet secretary.
The DeVos family has supported opponents of mine in the past, and it looks like they’re ready to double down on this Senate race.
**Republican Mike Rogers' latest FEC report was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family -- contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day, just before the September 30th deadline.**
Mike Rogers has already started to see a flood of support from deep-pocketed Republican donors like Betsy DeVos, corporate PACs, and Super PACs who will all spend millions of dollars on his behalf in order to flip Michigan red. In 2020, the DeVos family contributed over $1.6 million to candidates and PACs which have spent over $10 million to super PACs to influence races like ours.
So these contributions are just the beginning of the support Mike Rogers will receive from this powerful family.
But this campaign has something Mike Rogers' campaign lacks: lots and lots of regular people giving what they can, when they can.
Just one peek behind-the-curtain of Mike Rogers' FEC report shows he raised less than 5% of his money from individuals making small-dollar donations.
By contrast, the majority of the donations we receive come from people contributing significantly smaller donations than the DeVos family made to Mike Rogers: Our average email donation was $26 last quarter.
And what you may not know is that the single greatest source of individual donations to our campaign is the response to emails like this.
That’s why I would love to earn your support today. body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, big news!

On Tuesday (Oct. 24th), Our Revolution will hold a LIVE Healthcare for All Town Hall with Reps. Barbara Lee, Ro Khanna and Pramila Jayapal, the chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, along with CA Assemblyman Ash Kalra.

https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/10284?source=EM_NBI_OR_20231019_INV_healthcaretownhall_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_healthcaretownhall&t=1011&akid=4805%2E5885482%2Eukr8-9

RSVP (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/10284?source=EM_NBI_OR_20231019_INV_healthcaretownhall_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_healthcaretownhall&t=1012&akid=4805%2E5885482%2Eukr8-9)

We’ll talk about CalCare single payer healthcare in California and the path to national Medicare for All, as well as medical debt, drug prices, and how we can chart a path to healthcare justice in America.

RSVP here to be part of the conversation! The Live Town Hall event kicks off at 6pm Pacific/9pm Eastern on Tuesday! (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/10284?source=EM_NBI_OR_20231019_INV_healthcaretownhall_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_healthcaretownhall&t=1013&akid=4805%2E5885482%2Eukr8-9)

We are thrilled to have this powerful lineup of healthcare justice champions working alongside Our Revolution and our progressive movement for universal healthcare in California and beyond.

Healthcare is a human right, and it’s long past time for America to adopt a single payer system. Winning CalCare would be a huge step forward in advancing the fight for Medicare for All nationwide.

Join Barbara Lee, Ro Khanna, Pramila Jayapal, Ash Kalra, and our progressive coalition for this LIVE Healthcare for All town hall! (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/10284?source=EM_NBI_OR_20231019_INV_healthcaretownhall_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_healthcaretownhall&t=1014&akid=4805%2E5885482%2Eukr8-9)

Hope to see you there!

When we organize, we win

Our Revolution

Jim Jordan has had a rough time trying to become House speaker — somehow getting fewer Republican votes on his second try than his first.
It’s not shocking: Jordan is a far-right extremist who sought to overturn the 2020 election and whose views and values are out of step with everyday Americans. He’s the wrong choice.

body:
Just this week, a billionaire-backed, Republican super PAC started running attack ads against WFP’s Kendra Brooks and her running mate Nicolas O’Rourke, who are both running for Philadelphia City Council on the Working Families Party ballot line to build | | | Peter,
**Just this week, a billionaire-backed, Republican super PAC started running attack ads against WFP’s Kendra Brooks and her running mate Nicolas O’Rourke,** who are both running for Philadelphia City Council on the Working Families Party ballot line to build a city for the many — and to kick Republicans off the City Council. This is the _same_ Republican super PAC that spent over $1 million last spring to try and buy Philadelphia’s mayoral race with dark money smears. **These ads are deceptive and fearmongering** — but they’re reaching more and more voters every day. Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

body:
Time sensitive!? ? ? ? ? Peter,

We have exciting new House races to tell you about: Andrei Cherny (AZ-1), Christina Bohannan (IA-1), Gabe Amo (RI-1), and Monica Tranel (MT-1) are now on GiveGreen and need your support to defeat their anti-environment opponents.

All four of these races are incredible opportunities that will be essential to taking back the pro-environment majority in the House next year ? but since they are running against polluter-backend opponents, they will need the support of climate donors like you to push them to victory!

We have seen over the past couple months how chaotic the House is under an anti-environment majority ? we must flip the chamber next year to ensure we have real climate leadership. These four races could be critical in flipping the majority!

Are you all in to flip the House next year? Then please help elect Andrei Cherny, Christina Bohannan, Gabe Amo, and Monica Tranel by donating to their campaigns through GiveGreen today! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/WabwQx_jDVJ8/WGw5V2hWc2tEdGZvQlZjS1E3SUN6MXpsaDR5allib3FkajdvdlMvWG5sV3pUZG9oUXUyWjJxVzdvaW9NRnZYQWs2UEk1a00yRmhSQ2xFTEpFRkcxOW1teTF5dHZSaUxqY2FqSExjSGNTb0k9S0/ DONATE https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/YYbZByXDNGt0/WGw5V2hWc2tEdGZvQlZjS1E3SUN6MXpsaDR5allib3FkajdvdlMvWG5sV3pUZG9oUXUyWjJxVzdvaW9NRnZYQWs2UEk1a00yRmhSQ2xFTEpFRkcxOW1teTF5dHZSaUxqY2FqSExjSGNTb0k9S0/
Andrei Cherny is running to represent Arizona's 1st district. He has spent much of his life dedicated to fighting the climate crisis and protecting our democracy and founded a sustainable investing firm that has planted over 100 million trees around the world while helping millions move personal bank deposits away from institutions that used their deposits to fund oil and gas pipelines and drilling.

Christina Bohannan is running to represent Iowa's 1st district. She has a degree in environmental engineering from the University of Florida and began her career as an environmental engineer working to protect clean water. A former Iowa state legislator, she served on the Natural Resources Committee and the Appropriations Subcommittee on Agriculture and Natural Resources. She sponsored legislation on solar energy tax credits, testing for lead in water at schools and childcare facilities, and lead and copper testing in county water systems.

Gabe Amo is running to represent Rhode Island's 1st district. He has spent his career in public service ? having worked for Presidents Barack Obama and Joe Biden, U.S. Senator Sheldon Whitehouse, and former Governor and current Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo. In Congress, he will be committed to swift and equitable implementation of the Inflation Reduction Act to address climate change and create clean energy jobs.

Monica Tranel is running to represent Montana's 1st district. A former staff attorney for the Montana Public Service Commission, she is running to achieve an equitable transition to a clean energy future, invest in farmers and fossil fuel communities during the transition, increase climate resiliency, protect clean air, expand access to public transportation, and protect our public lands.

Winning back a pro-environment majority in the House means we need to compete and win in every corner of the country, starting with these four races: Donate to their campaigns through GiveGreen today to help them win! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/vNR6fe08aXQ0/WGw5V2hWc2tEdGZvQlZjS1E3SUN6MXpsaDR5allib3FkajdvdlMvWG5sV3pUZG9oUXUyWjJxVzdvaW9NRnZYQWs2UEk1a00yRmhSQ2xFTEpFRkcxOW1teTF5dHZSaUxqY2FqSExjSGNTb0k9S0/

Thanks for all that you do, Peter,

Gene Karpinski

**BREAKING: Jamie Raskin floats Liz Cheney... as consensus speaker option** After Cheney stood up to Donald Trump and participated in the January 6th Committee, she earned the respect of a lot of Americans.

body:
| Let me tell you about my pre-existing condition:
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=1356%2E35263%2EnPRyVu)
Hi Peter, can I share something with you? When I was young, I was diagnosed with a serious illness that resulted in three months in the hospital. When I recovered, my grandparents, who raised me, searched for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. They wanted to make sure I was protected in case I got sick again. Unfortunately, they couldn't find a policy that would cover me because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. All because I had a _"pre-existing condition."_ My grandparents had to pay for my health care out of pocket, and they had to make significant sacrifices to do so. I saw my grandparents worry about me and worry about how they would pay for my care. **I got into public service because I believed no one should have to go through this.** My story isn't a unique one — it's an experience shared by 133 million Americans living with pre-existing conditions. Before the _Affordable Care Act_ was passed, people with pre-existing conditions could be denied coverage. Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health care reform and to allow young people to stay on their parent's insurance plan until they turn 26. These changes have helped millions of Americans get the health insurance they need. But now, Republicans are attacking our health care and threatening the protections for people with pre-existing conditions. If Mitch McConnell and Republicans take back the Senate, they could take away the progress we've made and put insurance companies back in charge. I fought against Republican efforts to repeal the _Affordable Care Act_ before, and I will continue to defend it. **But I can't do it alone, Peter. clean_body: | Let me tell you about my pre-existing condition: Hi Peter, can I share something with you? When I was young, I was diagnosed with a serious illness that resulted in three months in the hospital. When I recovered, my grandparents, who raised me, searched for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. They wanted to make sure I was protected in case I got sick again. Unfortunately, they couldn't find a policy that would cover me because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. All because I had a "pre-existing condition." My grandparents had to pay for my health care out of pocket, and they had to make significant sacrifices to do so. I saw my grandparents worry about me and worry about how they would pay for my care. I got into public service because I believed no one should have to go through this. My story isn't a unique one — it's an experience shared by 133 million Americans living with pre-existing conditions. Before the Affordable Care Act was passed, people with pre-existing conditions could be denied coverage. Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health care reform and to allow young people to stay on their parent's insurance plan until they turn 26. These changes have helped millions of Americans get the health insurance they need. But now, Republicans are attacking our health care and threatening the protections for people with pre-existing conditions. If Mitch McConnell and Republicans take back the Senate, they could take away the progress we've made and put insurance companies back in charge. I fought against Republican efforts to repeal the Affordable Care Act before, and I will continue to defend it. But I can't do it alone, Peter.
